Conclusion: EgoTac 的核心贡献在于：首次提供了一条从第一人称人类视频中可扩展地提取触觉先验（tactile priors）的统一路径，利用大规模异源数据弥合视觉与触觉模态间的鸿沟，使机器人可在缺乏真实触觉标注的场景下获得丰富的触觉感知能力。其意义在于推动大规模触觉感知机器人学习和触觉感知的泛化。潜在局限包括：触觉预测的精度高度依赖视觉中可见的接触线索，对于视觉遮蔽或传感器-场景分布剧烈变化的情形鲁棒性可能受限；且模型输出为推断触觉而非真实传感器读数，在安全关键操作中的可靠性仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: Touch is fundamental to dexterous manipulation, yet most egocentric human data increasingly used for robot learning lacks tactile information. Directly collecting large-scale tactile data is challenging due to sensor limitations, while human video data is abundant, contact-rich, and easily scalable. This motivates a natural question: can tactile signals be inferred purely from vision? To address this, we introduce EgoTac, a generalizable model that predicts rich tactile information directly from egocentric human videos. EgoTac is trained on a unified corpus of over 5.7M image-tactile pairs, covering both continuous force measurements and binary contacts. By learning from this diverse dataset, EgoTac captures nuanced touch dynamics across varied interactions. Experiments demonstrate strong performance: in-domain prediction achieves an average force error below 0.06N. On out-of-domain contact prediction benchmarks, EgoTac consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art contact estimator. It also captures the rise and fall patterns of real tactile data and enables zero-shot predictions on unconstrained real-world videos. Scaling analyses further reveal that both data diversity and volume improve performance steadily. Overall, EgoTac provides a scalable pathway to extract tactile priors from egocentric human videos, enabling broadly applicable tactile-aware robot learning.

</details>


### [49] [Do Visual Grounding Decoders Need Feed-Forward Networks? A Controlled Study over Frozen Vision-Language Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15061)
*Tarun Tomar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过系统对比实验，研究了视觉定位（visual grounding）解码器中前馈网络（FFN）的必要性。在冻结的预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）特征上，作者比较了四块纯自注意力解码器（A4）、四块带FFN的标准解码器（S4）和八块纯注意力解码器（A8）。结果表明，在RefCOCOg和Ref-Adv-s上A4可与S4持平或略超；在FineCops-Ref上A4仅落后0.52个百分点（IoU@0.5），而A8不仅完全弥补该差距，还领先S4达0.26个百分点。A4将可训练解码器参数减少44.4%，缓存解码延迟降低10.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉定位任务通常采用"预训练VLM编码 + 可训练解码器"的范式。传统解码器（如MDETR风格）标配自注意力层加FFN模块，但FFN在解码器中的实际贡献从未被严格检验。作者质疑：当VLM编码器已经充分编码了图像和语言上下文后，解码器中的FFN是否仍是必要计算？该问题直接关系到模型参数量、推理延迟和部署成本，对追求高效实时感知系统（如机器人、UAV视觉定位）具有实际意义。

Method: 作者设计了严格受控的消融实验框架：(1) A4：四层纯自注意力解码器（移除FFN），作为最小基线；(2) S4：四层标准"注意力+FFN"解码器，与A4参数量匹配（总参数可比）；(3) A8：八层纯自注意力解码器，其参数量与S4相当，作为参数控制组，用于区分"FFN是否必要"与"参数量是否充分"两个问题。所有实验均在冻结VLM特征上、使用相同训练设置进行，并通过95%置信区间（CI）报告A4与S4的性能差异，以评估统计显著性。作者还测量了可训练解码器参数量、缓存解码延迟（cached-decoder latency）和端到端延迟。

Result: 主要实验设定包括RefCOCOg、健壮性基准Ref-Adv-s以及具有挑战性的FineCops-Ref数据集，后者的官方难度等级用于探究差距是否随难度单调增长。关键结果：(1) 在RefCOCOg和Ref-Adv-s上，A4匹配或略微超过S4；(2) 在FineCops-Ref上，A4在IoU@0.5处存在0.52个百分点的小幅劣势（95% CI [0.12, 0.95]偏向S4）；(3) A8完全消除劣势并领先S4 0.26个百分点；(4) FineCops官方难度等级上，A4与S4的差距不随难度单调增加；(5) A4较S4减少44.4%的可训练解码器参数，缓存解码延迟降低10.1%，但端到端延迟仍由骨干网络主导。

Conclusion: 核心贡献在于首次系统量化了VLM视觉定位解码器中FFN的边际价值：在大多数标准基准上FFN几乎不带来收益，即使在最难的FineCops-Ref上，其优势也可通过增加注意力层数（A8）完全实现甚至超越，说明解码器性能瓶颈在于自注意力容量而非非线性FFN映射。附带效率收益（-44.4%参数、-10.1%缓存解码延迟）对边缘部署有实用价值。局限在于：(1) 结论仅针对可训练定位解码器，不适用于未预训练的无注意力完整VLM；(2) 端到端延迟收益受骨干网络主导而有限；(3) FFN的作用可能随VLM编码质量或冻结与否而不同，泛化边界需进一步验证。

Abstract: Do feed-forward networks (FFNs) in visual grounding decoders add essential computation once a pretrained vision-language model has already encoded image and language context? We compare a four-block attention-only decoder (A4), a matched four-block attention-plus-FFN decoder (S4), and an eight-block attention-only parameter control (A8) over frozen VLM features. A4 matches or slightly exceeds S4 on RefCOCOg and Ref-Adv-s. FineCops-Ref reveals a small A4 deficit of 0.52 percentage points at IoU@0.5 (95% CI [0.12, 0.95] in favor of S4), but A8 recovers it and finishes 0.26 points above S4. Official FineCops levels do not show a monotonic increase in the gap. A4 reduces trainable decoder parameters by 44.4% and cached-decoder latency by 10.1%, although end-to-end latency remains backbone-dominated. These results concern the trainable grounding decoder, not a complete attention-only VLM.

</details>


### [50] [SA-GEM: Scale-Adaptive and Geospatial Evidence-Modulated Token Pruning for Efficient Remote Sensing Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15075)
*Kexin Ma,Jing Xiao,Bowen Xing,Liang Liao,Chia-Wen Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SA-GEM（Scale-Adaptive and Geospatial Evidence-Modulated Token Pruning），一种即插即用的视觉token剪枝框架，面向遥感大视觉语言模型（RS-LVLMs）。其核心思想是：在保持推理准确性的前提下，通过任务自适应的分辨率选择和联合建模任务相关性、空间结构、局部冗余的token重要性调制，解决高分辨率影像中视觉token数量随分辨率平方增长而重要证据被稀释的问题。在XLRS-Bench上，SA-GEM相较GeoLLaVA-8K在准确率上提升2.3%，并获得2.4倍总推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥感大视觉语言模型（RS-LVLMs）已显著提升了地球观测影像的多模态理解能力，但其性能受限于高分辨率处理：视觉token数量随输入线性分辨率呈平方级增长，而重要的视觉证据本质上是稀疏的，且在高分辨率扩展序列中被持续稀释。现有token剪枝方法大多采用与尺度无关的分辨率策略和孤立的显著性线索（如仅依据CLS token或局部注意力），既无法实现与任务对齐的粒度自适应，也无法保持对整体地理空间证据的感知。因此，需要一种既能任务自适应分配token粒度，又能整体调制地理空间token重要性的机制，以在精度与效率之间取得平衡。

Method: SA-GEM框架包含两个核心模块：（1）轻量级分辨率路由器（scale router）：根据查询（query）相关的token粒度需求选择合适的输入分辨率，避免对"更高分辨率必然更好"这一假设的盲目依赖，实现任务对齐的自适应尺度选择；（2）token重要性调制器（importance modulator）：联合建模任务相关性（task relevance）、空间结构（spatial structure）与局部冗余（local redundancy）三个维度，对token重要性进行整体评判，从而在剪枝时保留完整的地理空间证据。该框架采用即插即用（plug-and-play）设计，可无缝集成到现有RS-LVLM中。其关键洞见是：当粒度足够时，token质量（quality）比token数量（quantity）更重要——即达到一定分辨率后，增加分辨率带来的边际收益有限，反而应重点保证保留token的信息质量。

Result: 论文在多个基准数据集上进行了实验，并与现有剪枝方法对比，验证了SA-GEM在准确率和效率上的一致提升。具体而言，在XLRS-Bench基准上，SA-GEM相较GeoLLaVA-8K取得2.3%的准确率提升，同时实现2.4倍的总推理加速。实验结果表明较高的分辨率并非普遍有益，一旦达到足够的粒度，保留的token质量（即证据完整性）比token数量更关键，从而验证了论文的核心假设。

Conclusion: SA-GEM的主要贡献在于：（1）首次将尺度自适应与整体地理空间证据调制统一到一个即插即用的token剪枝框架中，打破了现有方法"尺度无关分辨率策略+孤立重要性线索"的局限；（2）通过轻量级路由器实现任务/查询相关的分辨率选择，并用联合多维重要性调制器保留整体的地理空间证据，兼顾任务对齐的粒度适应与证据完整性；（3）实验证明"足够分辨率下token质量优于数量"这一洞见，在精度与效率上均取得增益。潜在局限包括：对分辨率选择的粒度敏感性、路由器与调制器的联合调参成本，以及其推理加速具体省去了哪些计算环节（如视觉编码器、LLM前向）在摘要中未详细说明；此外，其泛化性在跨不同RS-LVLM架构上的表现有待进一步验证。

Abstract: RS-LVLMs have advanced multimodal understanding of Earth observation imagery, yet their performance is fundamentally constrained by high-resolution processing, as visual token counts grow quadratically with linear input resolution while important visual evidence is inherently sparse and increasingly diluted across the expanded sequence. Existing token pruning methods largely rely on scale-agnostic resolution policies and isolated importance cues, limiting task-aligned granularity adaptation and holistic evidence preservation. To address this, we present Scale-Adaptive and Geospatial Evidence-Modulated Token Pruning (SA-GEM), a plug-and-play framework that unifies task-adaptive token granularity allocation with holistic geospatial token importance modulation. Specifically, a lightweight router selects the resolution based on query-dependent token granularity, while a token importance modulator jointly models task relevance, spatial structure, and local redundancy to preserve holistic geospatial evidence. We show that higher resolution is not universally beneficial and, once sufficient granularity is reached, token quality matters more than token quantity. Experiments across various benchmarks demonstrate that SA-GEM achieves consistent gains in both accuracy and efficiency over existing pruning methods. On XLRS-Bench, it surpasses GeoLLaVA-8K by 2.3% in accuracy with a 2.4 times total inference speedup.

</details>


### [51] [Distribution-free false-alarm calibration and chance-corrected spatial evaluation for industrial anomaly detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15090)
*Jie Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对工业视觉缺陷检测中AUROC和掩膜重叠度指标无法反映特定阈值下的误报率、且缺陷位置重复和掩膜几何可能虚增重叠度的问题，提出将"无分布假设的上容忍阈值"与"配对减去交叉的空间检验"相结合。该检验比较每个检测器贡献分数的位置与匹配缺陷掩膜及来自其他图像的掩膜之间的重叠率差异，定义为相对经验偶然重叠率的空间证据提升（spatial-evidence lift）。在120张点缺陷图像（三个ISP-AD模态及三个固定数据划分）上评估三种检测器，378个报警中230个与匹配掩膜重叠，但9个检测器-模态单元中有8个配对与交叉率相似；仅DINOv2-ASM有正的95%自举下界（lift 0.259）。在Magnetic Tile Defect数据集上，WRN50 patch memory和ViT-B/16 patch memory分别给出0.203和0.231的提升，置换检验p=10^-5。精确样本规划显示150个校准正常样本仅支持1.98%及以上的目标假阳性率，1%目标需至少299个正常样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业视觉检测的研究普遍以AUROC和异常图与缺陷掩膜的重叠度作为核心评估指标，但这两类指标存在明显缺陷：(1) AUROC不指定在某个选定阈值下的误报率（false-alarm rate），难以支撑实际部署中的操作点选择；(2) 缺陷位置可能在数据集中重复出现，且掩膜的几何形状本身可虚增重叠度，使得原始重叠指标高估检测器的真实空间定位能力。论文旨在提出一种机会校正（chance-corrected）的统计评估方法，将报告重点转向操作点性能和空间证据，而不仅是累积曲线面积和原始重叠度。

Method: 论文提出两部分的统计评估框架。首先，采用无分布假设的上容忍阈值（distribution-free upper tolerance threshold），以校准的正常样本确定在给定置信度下支持某一目标假阳性率所需的操作阈值。其次，提出"配对减去交叉"空间检验（paired-minus-crossed spatial test）：对每个检测器，将分数贡献位置与匹配的缺陷掩膜（paired）比较，并与来自其他图像的掩膜（crossed）比较，两者重叠率之差定义为空间证据提升（spatial-evidence lift），以经验偶然重叠率为基准进行校正。当交叉掩膜被限制为同一缺陷类别时，评估同类约束下的稳健提升。同时给出基于自举的95%置信区间、单侧置换检验，以及精确样本规划（exact sample planning）来确定支持目标FPR所需的最少正常样本数。

Result: 在120张点缺陷图像（来自三个ISP-AD模态、三个固定数据划分）上评估三种检测器，共产生378个报警，其中230个与匹配掩膜重叠。然而在9个检测器-模态单元中，8个单元的配对重叠率与交叉重叠率在统计上无显著差异，表明原始重叠大部分可由偶然重叠解释；仅DINOv2-ASM获得正的95%自举下界（lift 0.259，95%区间0.159–0.347）。在独立的Magnetic Tile Defect数据集上，WRN50 patch memory给出lift 0.203（0.169–0.236），ViT-B/16 patch memory给出0.231（0.202–0.262），两者的单侧置换检验p=10^-5；当交叉掩膜限制为同一缺陷类别时，lift仍保持0.185和0.210。样本规划表明，150个校准正常样本仅在目标假阳性率≥1.98%时可支持95%置信的无分布声明；1%的目标需至少299个正常样本。

Conclusion: 论文的主要贡献是提出一套机会校正、操作点明确的工业缺陷检测评估框架：无分布容忍阈值用于校准真实误报率，配对减去交叉空间检验用于区分真实空间定位与偶然重叠。实验表明，在多数情形下原始重叠度量可被偶然重叠解释，凸显了chance-corrected评估的必要性；结论建议在AUROC和原始掩膜重叠之外，报告操作点性能和机会校正空间证据。局限性包括：证据来自有限的点缺陷图像及少数检测器-模态组合；样本规划数据规模（150–299个正常样本）表明对小目标假阳性率作高置信度声明所需校准数据较多；方法主要针对点缺陷场景，对大面积或复杂几何缺陷的推广有待验证。

Abstract: Studies of industrial visual inspection commonly report the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and the overlap between anomaly maps and defect masks. Neither measure specifies the false-alarm rate at a selected threshold, while recurrent defect locations and mask geometry can inflate overlap. We combine a distribution-free upper tolerance threshold with a paired-minus-crossed spatial test. This test compares each detector's score-contributing locations with the matched defect mask and with masks from other images; the difference in rates defines spatial-evidence lift relative to the empirical chance-overlap rate. Paired and crossed rates are nevertheless similar in eight of nine detector--modality cells; only DINOv2--ASM has a positive 95\% bootstrap lower bound (lift 0.259, 95\% interval 0.159--0.347). On the independent Magnetic Tile Defect dataset, the same analysis gives lifts of 0.203 (0.169--0.236) for Wide ResNet-50 (WRN50) patch memory and 0.231 (0.202--0.262) for Vision Transformer B/16 (ViT-B/16) patch memory, with one-sided permutation $p=10^{-5}$ for both. When crossed masks are restricted to the same defect class, the lifts remain 0.185 and 0.210. Exact sample planning shows that, with 150 calibration normals, a 95\%-confidence distribution-free claim is supported only for target false-positive rates of 1.98\% or higher; a 1\% target requires at least 299 normals. The results support reporting operating-point performance and chance-corrected spatial evidence alongside AUROC and raw mask overlap.

### [52] [MODAL: Multi-Modal Object Re-ID via Model-Driven Sparse Decoupling and Text-Image Differential Filtering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15096)
*Chengbo Huang,Jun-Jie Huang,Long Lan,Tianrui Liu,Xueqiong Li,Yuanxi Peng,Xinwang Liu,Meng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MODAL，一种基于耦合稀疏编码理论和微分抑制原则的多模态目标重识别框架。其核心是模型驱动的深度展开多模态特征稀疏解耦模块，将特征显式分解为单模态特异、双模态和三模态共享表示，并配合模态感知子空间激活缓解模态缺失场景性能退化，以及文本-图像差分滤波模块以粗粒度文本语义抑制视觉表示中的任务无关响应。在四个数据集上实现最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态目标重识别旨在利用视觉（RGB、NIR、TIR）与文本模态的互补信息实现跨摄像头目标检索。然而现有方法缺乏原则性的特征解耦和连贯的多模态融合，导致纠缠特征引发跨模态冲突、掩盖判别性线索，并在模态缺失条件下出现分布漂移。这一问题在复杂环境（如跨光谱、夜间、远距离）中尤为关键，因为不同摄像头或时段的可用模态往往不完整，直接影响跨摄像头检索的鲁棒性。

Method: MODAL框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于多模态耦合稀疏编码的多模态特征稀疏解耦模块（Multi-modal Feature Sparse Decoupling）。该模块采用模型驱动的深度展开方式，将多模态特征显式分解为单模态特异、双模态共享和三模态共享表示，实现透明有效的特征解耦，而非常规黑盒网络。(2) 模态感知子空间激活（Modality-Aware Subspace Activation）：得益于原则性解耦，在模态缺失场景下仅选择性激活一致共享的子空间，天然缓解不完整模态输入下的性能退化与分布偏移。(3) 文本-图像差分滤波模块（Text-Image Differential Filtering）：利用粗粒度文本语义自适应抑制解耦后视觉特征中的任务无关响应，增强判别信息。整体融合了差分抑制原则，实现各模态间的协调整合而非简单拼接。

Result: 实验在四个多模态Re-ID数据集上评估MODAL。结果表明MODAL在完整模态条件下达到最先进的检索性能，且具有更高的特征透明度和可解释性。重点验证了稀疏解耦对各模态独立判别能力和共享表示的有效性，以及模态缺失场景下通过子空间激活维持的性能稳定性，证明其优于现有的纠缠式多模态融合方法。

Conclusion: MODAL的主要贡献在于将耦合稀疏编码这一经典信号处理理论引入多模态重识别，通过模型驱动的深度展开实现原则性的多模态特征解耦，突破了主流黑盒融合方法在可解释性和模态缺失鲁棒性上的局限。其显式分解单/双/三模态共享表示的设计为多模态感知提供了更透明且可迁移的范式。潜在局限包括模型驱动的展开网络可能带来较高推理计算开销，以及对文本-图像差分滤波的粗粒度语义依赖在复杂描述场景下的鲁棒性有待进一步验证。

Abstract: Multi-modal object re-identification (Re-ID) aims to facilitate cross-camera object retrieval in complex environments by leveraging complementary information from visual (e.g., RGB, NIR, TIR) and textual modalities. However, existing approaches often lack principled feature disentanglement and coherent multi-modal integration, leading to entangled representations that introduce cross-modal conflicts, obscure discriminative cues, and suffer distribution shift under modality-missing conditions. To tackle these challenges, we propose MODAL, a novel multi-modal object re-identification framework, grounded in coupled sparse coding theory and differential suppression principles. A core component of MODAL is a Multi-modal Feature Sparse Decoupling module, developed in a model-driven deep unrolling manner based on multi-modal coupled sparse coding. It explicitly decomposes multi-modal features into uni-modal specific, bi-modal and tri-modal shared representations, thereby achieving more transparent and effective feature disentanglement. Benefiting from the principled feature disentanglement, MODAL naturally mitigates performance degradation in incomplete-modality scenarios via a Modality-Aware Subspace Activation that selectively activates only the consistently shared subspaces. Moreover, we propose a Text-Image Differential Filtering module that leverages coarse-grained textual semantics to adaptively suppress task-irrelevant responses in the decoupled visual representations, thereby enhancing discriminative information. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate that MODAL achieves state-of-the-art performance with superior transparency.

</details>


### [53] [ProjFormer: Point Cloud Completion via Geometric-Projective Transformer and Cross-Modal Semantic Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15104)
*Sheng Liu,Meng Wang,Ruihui Li,Huilong Pi,Zhuo Tang,Kenli Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ProjFormer提出一种跨模态点云补全框架，通过显式投影和自适应特征路由实现几何一致的2D-3D交互。其核心包含一个投影引导的视图注意力模块（利用确定性投影对齐3D点与多视图特征）和一个几何感知路由网络（对结构特征与观测驱动特征进行逐点自适应融合以实现渐进式细化），在轻量级设计下达到具有竞争力的性能并提升结构完整性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 点云补全本质上是不适定问题，因为部分观测存在严重稀疏性和歧义。现有基于多视图的方法虽然通过引入2D语义来缓解这一问题，但往往依赖学习式注意力与固定融合策略，缺乏几何一致性（投影关系不够准确）和适应性（无法根据局部几何特性动态调整特征融合方式）。这种缺陷限制了补全结果的几何保真度，因此需要一种能显式维护2D-3D几何对应并自适应融合多模态信息的方案。

Method: ProjFormer提出两阶段技术：(1) Projective Guided View Attention (PGVA)模块，通过确定性投影（相机内外参）将3D点精确对齐到多视图2D特征上，实现几何一致的跨视图特征聚合，替代完全依赖学习的注意力，兼顾效率与几何一致性；(2) 几何感知路由网络（geometry-aware routing network），对结构特征（来自3D先验）和观测驱动特征（来自2D多视图）进行逐点自适应融合，通过路由机制根据局部几何特性选择最优融合权重，实现渐进式细化补全。整体设计保持轻量高效。

Result: 实验在点云补全标准数据集上进行（结合多视图RGB输入）。在轻量级模型设计下，ProjFormer达到与现有方法相当甚至更优的性能，尤其是在结构完整性指标上表现突出，证明了显式投影与自适应路由相对固定融合在学习式注意力方法上的有效性。论文强调了轻量化设计下竞争力的保持。

Conclusion: ProjFormer的主要贡献在于：用确定性投影机制取代纯学习式注意力以强化几何一致性，并通过几何感知路由实现自适应的逐点跨模态融合，在效率和精度之间取得良好平衡。其局限性在于论文未充分展开消融细节与计算复杂度量化对比，且方法对多视图相机标定精度有一定依赖，在相机位姿未知或标定噪声较大的场景中表现尚需验证。

Abstract: Point cloud completion is inherently ill-posed due to severe sparsity and ambiguity in partial observations. Existing multi-view methods alleviate this by incorporating 2D semantics, but often rely on learned attention and fixed fusion, which lack geometric consistency and adaptability. We propose ProjFormer, a cross-modal framework that enforces geometry-consistent 2D-3D interaction through explicit projection and adaptive feature routing. A Projective Guided View Attention module aligns 3D points with multi-view features via deterministic projection, enabling efficient and geometrically consistent aggregation. Building on this, a geometry-aware routing network performs point-wise adaptive fusion of structural and observation-driven features for progressive refinement. Experiments show that, under a lightweight design, ProjFormer delivers competitive performance with improved structural completeness.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: CETalk的核心贡献在于：(1) 首次将连续VA表示引入音频驱动的3D说话头生成，克服了离散情感类别的表达能力瓶颈；(2) 提出多尺度时间建模解耦发音与情感频率，解决了时间频率错配问题；(3) 构建了带VA标注的3D面部运动数据集3D-VA-MEAD，填补了该方向数据资源空白。局限在于VA标注为自动估计，可能存在标注噪声；且情感控制的可解释性和跨数据集泛化能力有待进一步验证。该方法对于数字人、虚拟人和人机交互等需要细粒度情感表达的应用具有重要参考价值。

Abstract: Emotional 3D talking head generation aims to synthesize expressive facial animations with accurate lip synchronization. However, existing methods often rely on discrete emotion categories, which fail to capture the continuous evolution of affect. They also overlook the temporal frequency mismatch between audio articulation and emotional expression. In this paper, we propose CETalk, an audio-driven 3D facial animation framework conditioned on continuous Valence--Arousal (VA) representations for fine-grained emotion control. CETalk predicts a sequence of FLAME parameters through three key components: a Dynamic Emotion Modulation Module that adaptively scales emotional intensity using audio-derived cues; a Multi-Scale Temporal Modeling mechanism that employs parallel branches to decouple high-frequency articulatory movements from low-frequency emotional dynamics; and a Dynamic Fusion Mechanism that integrates these multi-scale features via an adaptive gating network. To support training and evaluation, we construct 3D-VA-MEAD, a large-scale dataset with automatically estimated VA annotations and reconstructed 3D facial motions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CETalk outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both lip-sync accuracy and emotional expressiveness, while enabling smooth and controllable emotion transitions.

### [55] [Fast Test-Time Refinement for Robust Learned Image Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15113)
*Jiaming Liang,Chi-Man Pun,Weisi Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了学习型图像压缩（LIC）系统在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性问题，发现并证明了LIC系统中存在"非对称对抗轨迹"（AAT）性质：从对抗区域恢复到良性区域仅需1-2步。基于此性质提出快速测试时精炼（FTTR）框架，实现高效且稳健的LIC系统，并以二维Tube模型从理论上解释了鲁棒性来源于Input-as-Label性质导致的对抗区域收缩，而非梯度模糊。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LIC虽然在下良环境下表现优异的率失真性能，但深度神经网络的高表征能力引入了严重的对抗脆弱性，阻碍其作为可信标准化编码器被采用。已有的测试时精炼（TTR）方法在灰盒场景下可作防御，但存在两大未解问题：(1) 大量迭代带来高昂计算开销，缺乏实用性；(2) 鲁棒性机制缺乏理论理解。此外，TTR从未在白盒场景或超出ℓ₂范数约束的攻击下评估。这些问题阻碍了可信LIC系统的落地。

Method: 论文核心贡献有三：(1) 发现并通过系统实验揭示LIC系统的AAT（Asymmetric Adversarial Trajectory）性质——从对抗样本恢复到良性区域比反向过程显著容易，通常仅需1-2步即可近似复原；(2) 提出二维Tube模型从理论上解释AAT现象；(3) 提出快速测试时精炼（FTTR）框架，利用AAT性质以极少迭代实现高效防御。论文还建立了理论论证，证明鲁棒性源于LIC系统Input-as-Label属性引起的对抗区域收缩，而非梯度模糊/隐藏。

Result: 论文在多个LIC系统上，针对多种强自适应攻击（包括白盒场景、ℓ₂-范数约束的速率攻击以及非目标失真攻击等多种攻击目标）进行了广泛评估。实验验证了AAT性质的存在（1-2步快速恢复），并证明FTTR在显著降低迭代开销的同时保持鲁棒防御性能，展示了其在多样化攻击设定下的有效性。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 本文是首个系统研究LIC对抗鲁棒性机制的工作，通过揭示AAT性质并建立Tube模型，为TTR类防御提供了理论基础，突破了此前黑箱经验性应用的限制。FTTR框架兼具高效性与鲁棒性，推进了可信LIC系统的实用化。局限在于AAT性质及其Tube模型的理论完备性仍有待进一步严格验证，且FTTR对更多样的攻击类型和更广泛编解码架构的泛化能力尚需更多实证。

Abstract: Learned image compression (LIC) has demonstrated remarkable rate-distortion (RD) performance in benign settings. However, the high representational capacity endowed by deep neural networks (DNNs) comes at the expense of increased adversarial vulnerability. This hinders their adoption as trusted standardized codecs. Recent work has sketched test-time refinement (TTR) as a defense in gray-box scenarios, despite its original purpose of improving benign RD performance. Unfortunately, extensive iterations of TTR incur prohibitive overhead, while the robustness mechanism lacks theoretical understanding. Moreover, TTR has not been evaluated in white-box settings or against attacks beyond $\ell_2$-bounded rate and untargeted distortion objectives. To bridge these gaps, we present a systematic study. Our study reveals an Asymmetric Adversarial Trajectory (AAT) property in LIC systems: transitioning from adversarial to benign regions is significantly easier than the reverse process, where adversarial examples can often be roughly recovered within only 1-2 steps. We provide a two-dimensional Tube Model to explain this phenomenon. Based on AAT, we propose a Fast Test-Time Refinement (FTTR) framework for practical and robust LIC systems. We establish that the robustness arises from the contraction of adversarial regions induced by the Input-as-Label property of LIC systems, rather than from obfuscated gradients. Extensive evaluations with diverse strong adaptive attacks across multiple LIC systems demonstrate the promise of the proposed FTTR framework. The code is available at https://github.com/chinaliangjiaming/FTTR.git.

*Kaisheng Liang,Yiming Cao,Bin Xiao*

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于视角不变性的对抗样本攻击方法 PIA (Perspective-Invariant Attack)，通过多自由度顶点采样策略系统覆盖从 2-DOF 平移到 8-DOF 射影变换的几何变换层级，以增强对抗扰动的跨模型迁移性。同时提出通用扩展 PIA-Mix，通过维护互补变换池将视角变换与现有辅助方法高效结合，进一步提升迁移攻击性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在替代 DNN 上生成的对抗样本往往能成功欺骗其他黑盒 DNN 模型，这种跨模型迁移性对现实应用中的 DNN 构成严重安全威胁。现有的输入变换技术（如块级打乱、缩放）主要通过局部操作提升输入多样性，但自由度（DOF）有限，忽略了自然来源于视角变化的全局透视变换。这一缺陷限制了对抗扰动对替代模型过拟合的抑制能力，从而制约了对抗迁移性的进一步提升。

Method: PIA 的核心创新在于多自由度顶点采样策略，该策略系统地覆盖透视变换层级，从 2-DOF 平移逐步扩展到 8-DOF 射影映射。通过对输入图像生成几何多样化的变化，PIA 有效降低对抗扰动对替代模型的过拟合，从而提升跨模型迁移性。在此基础上，PIA-Mix 作为通用扩展，维护一个互补变换池，将透视变换与现有辅助变换方法高效组合，以获得更优的迁移性。

Conclusion: PIA 首次将透视变换及其多自由度层级引入对抗迁移攻击，弥补了现有方法忽视全局视角变换的不足；PIA-Mix 提供了通用的互补变换组合框架。其意义在于揭示了视角几何变换作为输入多样化手段对提升对抗迁移性的重要价值。潜在局限可能包括计算开销随自由度采样增加而上升，以及黑盒环境下攻击效能与实际部署条件之间的差距。

Abstract: Adversarial examples generated on a surrogate deep neural network (DNN) can often successfully fool other black-box DNN models. This cross-model transferability poses serious security threats to DNNs in practical applications. Input transformation techniques are widely used to enhance adversarial transferability by increasing the diversity of input images. However, existing methods primarily rely on local operations with limited degrees of freedom (DOF), such as block-wise shuffling and resizing, overlooking global perspective transformations that naturally arise from viewpoint changes. In this work, we propose a Perspective-Invariant Attack (PIA), which introduces a multi-DOF vertex sampling strategy that systematically covers the perspective transformation hierarchy from 2-DOF translation to 8-DOF projective mapping. By generating geometrically diverse input variations, PIA effectively reduces overfitting of adversarial perturbations to the surrogate model, thereby improving adversarial transferability. We further propose PIA-Mix, a generic extension that maintains a complementary transformation pool and efficiently combines our perspective transformation with auxiliary methods for improved transferability. Extensive experiments involving various DNN architectures, advanced defense mechanisms, and multimodal large language models (LLMs) demonstrate that PIA and PIA-Mix outperform state-of-the-art transfer-based attacks.

### [57] [HOIMask: Towards Generative Masked Modeling for Human Object Interaction Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15141)

TL;DR: HOIMask 是首个用于人体-物体交互（HOI）运动生成的离散空间生成式掩码建模框架。它通过 HOI 向量量化（VQ）将运动序列和接触感知信号编码为 2D 人体/物体离散 token 图（而非传统 1D 表示），利用掩码建模的 Transformer 架构联合建模空间-时间与交互依赖，并在推理阶段引入离散空间的接触感知重建引导来优化 token，生成时空一致性更强、更物理合理的 HOI 运动，在多项指标上超越基于扩散的 SOTA 方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 HOI 运动生成主要由基于扩散的方法主导，其关键在于利用接触融合或接触信号引导扩散过程以提升交互质量。然而扩散方法在迭代去噪过程中存在误差累积，导致生成结果包含大量伪影（artifact）且交互质量不稳定。作者旨在解决这一核心缺陷，探索用生成式掩码建模（generative masked modeling）替代扩散范式，在离散 token 空间中建模 HOI 运动，以避免迭代去噪带来的误差累积，并更精细地保持运动的空间-时间结构。

Method: HOIMask 由三部分核心技术构成：1) HOI 向量量化（VQ）：将运动序列与接触感知信号联合编码为离散的 2D 人体和物体 token 图，相比传统 1D 表示能保留更细粒度的空间-时间结构；2) 生成式掩码建模框架：基于 Transformer 架构，联合捕获人体-物体交互的动态变化，显式建模复杂的空间-时间与交互依赖关系，在离散空间进行 token 的掩码预测与生成；3) 接触感知重建引导（contact-aware reconstruction guidance）：在推理阶段于离散空间中对 HOI token 进行优化，融合接触信号，强制生成的运动具备更高的空间-时间一致性，从而得到更连贯且物理合理的运动输出。

Result: 论文在 HOI 运动生成任务上进行了评估，与当前 SOTA 的基于扩散的方法对比，HOIMask 在生成动作的真实性（realism）与语义对齐（semantic alignment）方面均取得更优结果，即采用离散掩码建模和接触感知引导生成的 HOI 运动在多项质量与一致性指标上超越扩散基线。具体实验数据集与逐项数值指标在论文正文及项目页中提供。

Conclusion: HOIMask 的主要贡献在于：首次将 HOI 运动生成从扩散范式转向离散空间的生成式掩码建模，通过 2D 共享 token 图保留精细时空结构，并提出推理时的离散接触感知引导以增强时空一致性与物理合理性，有效解决了扩散方法误差累积导致的伪影与交互不稳定问题。局限在于其应用范围聚焦于 HOI 运动生成，通用性与跨数据集泛化能力仍待进一步验证。

Abstract: Diffusion-based methods have dominated the HOI generation, as they enable critical contact fusions or signals to guide the diffusion process. However, they often result in high artifacts and unstable interaction quality due to error accumulation during iterative denoising. In this work, we propose HOIMask, the first generative masked framework for modeling HOI motion in discrete space. HOIMask first encodes both motion sequences and contact-aware signals into discrete 2D human and object token maps via HOI Vector Quantization (VQ), preserving fine-grained spatial-temporal structure beyond conventional 1D representations. On this basis, a generative masked modeling framework is employed to jointly capture human-object interaction dynamics, leveraging a transformer architecture designed to model complex spatial-temporal and interaction dependencies. To generate more coherent and physically plausible motions, we further introduce a novel contact-aware reconstruction guidance in discrete space during inference, which fuses contact signals to optimize HOI tokens that forces the generated motion with higher spatio-temporal consistency. With craftily designed motion interaction tokens, dedicated architecture and guidance strategy, HOIMask outperforms state-of-the-art diffusion-based methods, generating more realistic and semantically aligned HOI motions. Please refer to https://jyhflash.github.io/HOIMask/ for more results.

</details>


### [58] [A Unified Backbone--Expert Framework with Relation-Token and Residual--Classifier Interfaces for Automatic Modulation Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15160)
*Zhixiang Deng,Houbiao Li,Zongyong Cui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一的"主干-专家接口"（backbone-expert）框架用于自动调制识别（AMR），以解决单一模型架构在不同观测长度下表现不一致的问题。框架采用共享卷积状态空间（state-space）主干，并针对短序列设计了显式滞后感知复平面描述符（relation tokens），针对长序列设计了门控多尺度残差细化模块与固定平均分类器协同机制。在RML2016.10b和HisarMod2019上分别达到67.28%±0.14%和87.19%±0.77%的平均准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动调制识别（AMR）在实际应用中面临观测长度（序列长度）多变的问题。现有研究表明，单一模型架构往往难以在短序列和长序列上都取得优异性能：短序列存在信息不足、特征提取易丢信息的瓶颈；长序列则存在冗余累积、特征图退化等问题。这种"一刀切"（one-size-fits-all）的架构设计阻碍了AMR在不同观测条件下的泛化能力，因而需要一种能够自适应观测长度、可解耦不同长度专用处理策略的统一框架。

Method: 框架由三部分构成：1）共享的卷积状态空间主干，作为通用特征提取器，统一处理不同长度的序列输入；2）短序列专用接口：在编码前注入显式的滞后感知（lag-aware）复平面描述符，作为关系token（relation tokens）补充信息，补偿短序列在时间和频率维度上的信息损失；3）长序列专用接口：设计门控多尺度残差细化模块（gated multi-scale residual refinement module）对特征图进行校正，并结合固定平均（fixed-averaging）分类器协作机制，融合互补的证据以抑制长序列中的冗余干扰。整体采用"主干共享、接口解耦"的设计哲学，使不同长度的序列各自获得针对性的处理策略。

Result: 方法在RML2016.10b和HisarMod2019两个标准AMR数据集上评估，采用三次运行的平均准确率（mean±样本标准差）作为指标：RML2016.10b上达67.28%±0.14%，HisarMod2019上达87.19%±0.77%。进一步通过三种子（three-seed）消融实验、原生长度跨配置测试以及受控窗口研究验证了框架有效性，实验结果确认了"专家接口解耦"相比单一通用架构的优势。

Conclusion: 主要贡献在于提出了一种针对可变观测长度的统一AMR框架，通过"共享主干+专用专家接口"的解耦设计同时优化了短序列与长序列的处理性能，避免了单一架构的权衡折中。研究意义在于为长度自适应信号感知提供了新思路。局限包括：评估数据集相对有限（两个数据集）、性能增益的通用性仍需在更多调制类型和更复杂信道条件下验证，且复平面描述符与门控残差机制的具体设计细节在当前摘要中未充分展开。

Abstract: Automatic modulation recognition (AMR) faces distinct representation bottlenecks under varying observation lengths, where a single model architecture often fails to excel. To address this, we propose a unified backbone-expert framework with a common convolutional state-space backbone and two specialized interfaces. For short sequences, we inject explicit lag-aware complex-plane descriptors as relation tokens before encoding to compensate for information loss. For long sequences, we design a gated multi-scale residual refinement module to correct the feature map, combined with a fixed-averaging classifier collaboration to harness complementary evidence. Our framework achieves overall average accuracies of 67.28 \pm 0.14% on RML2016.10b and 87.19 \pm 0.77% on HisarMod2019 (mean \pm sample standard deviation over three runs), respectively. The framework's efficacy is further validated through three-seed ablations, native-length cross-configuration tests, and controlled window studies, confirming the benefit of expert-interface decoupling over one-size-fits-all architectures.

</details>


### [59] [From "What-If" to "What-Is": Counterfactual Thinking-Inspired Semantic Alignment for Visual Brain Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15163)
*Kaitao Yan,Chi Liu,Congcong Zhu,Huajie Chen,Gengshen Wu,Minghao Wang,Xiaotong Han,Tianqing Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ConceptAlign，一个面向视觉大脑解码（visual brain decoding）的反事实语义对齐框架。该方法将解码后的视觉 token 池化并投影到冻结的文本嵌入空间，与真实标注对齐，同时与 LLM 离线生成的保持场景不变、仅修改一个关键对象/属性/关系的近误反事实样本进行分离，通过 margin-based 目标学习细粒度语义边界，无需推理时调用 LLM。在 Natural Scenes Dataset 上优于 MindEye2 骨干。

需要说明：本文属于大脑解码（fMRI-based visual reconstruction）领域，与事件相机/SNN 不直接相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉大脑解码用 fMRI 等神经信号重建人感知的视觉内容。现有基于多模态表示和扩散先验的方法虽提升了重建的真实感，但问题在于：强生成先验可能用"未被解码表示充分指定"的内容补全图像，导致视觉上看似合理却包含错误对象、属性或关系。而传统重建指标只评估最终图像，倾向于掩盖这类语义错误。因此核心动机是：如何在解码阶段对齐"语义正确"的表示，并区分"场景保留但语义错误"的近误解释，从而提升语义保真度而非仅仅是视觉逼真度。

Method: ConceptAlign 的核心流程：(1) 将视觉解码 token 进行池化并投影到冻结的文本嵌入空间，与 ground-truth 描述进行对齐。(2) 通过 LLM 离线生成"近误（near-miss）"反事实样本，每条仅修改一个关键对象、属性或关系，但保留整体场景结构，作为困难负样本。(3) 采用 margin-based 目标（对比损失），学习观测刺激与"合理但错误"解释之间的细粒度语义边界——即推动真实描述靠近解码表示，同时推开近误替代文本。(4) 推理阶段无需任何 LLM 调用，因为这些反事实样本仅用于训练。此外还提出了一个系统的三层语义评估框架：①基础判别力（foundational discriminability）②反事实描述判别③表征几何结构（representational geometry），用于在语义层面系统评测解码质量。

Result: 在 Natural Scenes Dataset 上以 MindEye2 为骨干预训练后进行实验。结果显示 ConceptAlign 在标准重建指标上有所提升，同时显著改善了对反事实语义的判别能力和表征对齐程度。消融实验采用匹配的负样本来源（matched negative-source ablations），并使用独立生成的 LLM 与人工编写的反事实替代样本验证监督信号的有效性。此外人类评估进一步支持了监督的稳健性，并在细粒度冲突场景、有限训练数据解码以及跨被试结构上呈现有利表现。

Conclusion: 主要贡献：提出面向大脑解码的反事实语义对齐框架 ConceptAlign，指出并解决了"视觉上合理但语义上错误"的重建问题；提出无需推理期 LLM 调用的高效训练机制；并贡献了三层语义评估体系，弥补传统重建指标难以捕捉语义错误的缺陷。局限性：反事实样本的质量依赖离线 LLM 生成，且评估主要围绕具体数据集与骨干（MindEye2）展开；方法对解码 token 池化与文本投影的方式存在一定假设，其跨数据集泛化和可扩展性仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: Visual brain decoding reconstructs visual content perceived by a person from neural measurements such as fMRI, providing a computational approach to studying how visual information is represented in the brain. Recent multimodal representations and diffusion priors have improved reconstruction realism. However, visually plausible reconstructions may contain incorrect objects, attributes, or relations because a strong generative prior can complete content not sufficiently specified by the decoded representation. Conventional reconstruction metrics mainly assess the final image and may therefore obscure such semantic errors. We propose ConceptAlign, a counterfactual semantic alignment framework for visual brain decoding. ConceptAlign pools decoded visual tokens and projects them into a frozen text-embedding space, aligning the representation with the ground-truth caption while separating it from scene-preserving near-miss alternatives. Generated offline by an LLM, these alternatives modify one critical object, attribute, or relation while retaining the scene. A margin-based objective learns fine-grained semantic boundaries between the observed stimulus and plausible but incorrect interpretations without requiring LLM calls during inference. We introduce a systematic three-level semantic evaluation framework covering foundational discriminability, counterfactual description discrimination, and representational geometry. Experiments on the Natural Scenes Dataset show that ConceptAlign improves reconstruction measures, counterfactual semantic discrimination, and representational alignment over the MindEye2 backbone. Matched negative-source ablations, independent LLM and human-written alternatives, and human evaluation support the effectiveness and robustness of the supervision, with favorable patterns in fine-grained conflicts, limited-data decoding, and cross-subject structure.

</details>


### [60] [Beyond Natural-Image Foundation Models: Benchmarking Satellite Pretraining for Ophthalmic Image Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15195)
*Lovre Antonio Budimir,Mingya Alexa Gong,Alyssa Foong Quinney,Ivana Matovinović,Yukun Zhou,Pearse A. Keane,Sven Lončarić,Marinko V. Šarunić*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出将卫星影像作为医学视觉基础模型（MedVFM）的全新预训练域，核心动机是卫星影像与医学数据在视觉结构上更接近（如血管网络与河流/道路拓扑），且不受医疗数据隐私限制。作者对比了在4.93亿张卫星图像上预训练的DINOv3-SAT493m、在17亿自然图像上预训练的DINOv3-LVD1689m，以及两个医学专科基线DINOv3-RETFound和MAE-RETFound。实验表明，在多模态眼科成像任务中，卫星预训练显著优于自然图像预训练，尤其在en face富含血管结构的模态上表现突出，且在部分高分辨率en face任务上无需任何医学数据即可匹配甚至超越医学专科模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学视觉基础模型（MedVFM）具有跨模态、跨解剖区域和跨临床任务的通用适应潜力，但其发展受限于三大瓶颈：(1) 医学数据量有限；(2) 数据涉及患者隐私难以大规模共享；(3) 开发成本高昂。为此，现有MedVFM通常基于大规模自然图像（如ImageNet）预训练的通用模型进行初始化，但自然图像与医学图像之间存在严重的分布偏移（distribution shift），导致下游医学任务适应效率低下。本文的核心洞察是：卫星影像可作为MedVFM的替代预训练域——它不仅在视觉结构上与医学图像（特别是视网膜血管、组织拓扑等）有更紧密的相似性，更重要的是不受医疗隐私约束，可大规模获取。这一思路为MedVFM开发提供了无需医学数据即可构建强预训练基础的新路径。

Method: 本文提出的技术路线可概括为"卫星影像作为MedVFM替代预训练域"，具体方法包括：

1. 预训练模型构建：采用DINOv3自监督视觉变换器（Vision Transformer）架构，使用4.93亿张卫星图像（SAT493m数据集）进行自监督预训练，得到DINOv3-SAT493m模型；对照模型为在17亿自然图像（LVD1689m）上预训练的DINOv3-LVD1689m，以及两个医学专科基线DINOv3-RETFound和MAE-RETFound（后者均基于视网膜OCT数据预训练）。

2. 对比框架设计：构建"通用域（卫星/自然）vs 医学专科域"的系统性对比，评估不同预训练数据域对下游眼科任务适应性的影响。

3. 多模态眼科评估：在多个眼科成像模态上（包括en face血管丰富模态等高分辨率输入）进行下游任务评估，验证预训练域选择对任务性能的影响。

关键创新在于：不改变模型架构和自监督预训练范式，仅通过替换预训练数据域为卫星影像，即可实现优于自然图像的医学任务下游适应，这表明预训练数据域的几何/拓扑结构与医学图像的对齐程度，比数据规模更重要。

Result: 实验设计：在多个眼科成像模态上，将DINOv3-SAT493m（4.93亿卫星图像预训练）与DINOv3-LVD1689m（17亿自然图像预训练）以及两个医学专科基线DINOv3-RETFound和MAE-RETFound进行系统对比。

主要发现：
1. 卫星影像作为预训练源在眼科任务上显著优于自然图像——即使在卫星数据量（4.93亿）远小于自然图像（17亿）的情况下，卫星预训练仍表现出更强的下游任务性能。

2. 性能优势在en face富含血管结构的模态上最为突出，这与卫星影像中河流、道路等管状拓扑结构与眼底血管网络在视觉形态上高度相似有关，支持了"视觉结构对齐优于数据规模"的核心论点。

3. 在多个任务上，卫星预训练模型在高分辨率en face输入下无需使用任何医学数据即可匹配甚至超越医学专科模型（RETFound系列），这挑战了"医学任务必须依赖医学数据预训练"的传统认知。

这一结果表明，预训练数据域的视觉/结构相关性与可扩展性（不受隐私限制），共同构成了MedVFM开发的核心杠杆。

Conclusion: 主要贡献：
1. 首次提出卫星影像作为MedVFM的替代预训练域，开辟了无需医学数据即可构建医学视觉基础的新路径，绕开了医疗数据隐私这一根本性约束。
2. 通过系统性实验证明，预训练数据的视觉结构对齐（而非单纯数据规模）对医学下游任务适应至关重要——卫星数据量仅为自然图像的约29%，却在眼科任务上全面胜出。
3. 展示了在en face等血管富集模态上，通用域预训练可在匹配甚至超越医学专科模型的性能，为MedVFM的规模化发展提供了新的数据策略。

潜在局限：
1. 评估范围集中于眼科（ophthalmic）模态，卫星预训练是否对其他医学领域（如放射影像、病理切片）同样有效仍需验证。
2. 优势主要体现在en face血管丰富模态，具体的适用边界尚不明确。
3. 卫星影像与医学图像的结构相似性机制（为何卫星预训练有效）需要更深入的理论解释。

Abstract: Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) have emerged as a promising approach in medical imaging, producing broadly applicable systems that can be efficiently adapted across diverse imaging modalities, anatomical regions, and clinical tasks. However, VFMs require extensive training data, and their progress in medical image analysis is constrained by limited data availability, privacy concerns, and high development costs. To alleviate these constraints, medical VFMs (MedVFMs) are often built upon weights from generalist models pretrained on vast amounts of publicly available natural images, introducing a substantial distribution shift for medical task adaptation. To address this, we propose satellite imagery as a novel pretraining domain for MedVFM development and benchmarking, motivated by its closer visual alignment with medical data and its freedom from the privacy constraints that limit medical datasets. Across multiple ophthalmic imaging modalities, we compare DINOv3-SAT493m pretrained on 493 million satellite images against DINOv3-LVD1689m pretrained on 1.7 billion natural images, together with two medical specialist baselines: DINOv3-RETFound and MAE-RETFound. Our experiments show that satellite imagery is a stronger pretraining source than natural images for ophthalmic tasks, particularly on en face vascular-rich modalities. On several tasks, satellite pretraining matches or exceeds the medical specialists on high-resolution en face inputs, despite using no medical data.

</details>


### [61] [Anchor-Regularized Adaptation for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection with DINOv3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15196)
*Hyeongjun Choi,Juhun Lee,Davide Cozzolino,Luisa Verdoliva,Simon S. Woo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Anchor-Regularized Adaptation (ARA)，通过在冻结的锚定分类器约束下进行 Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) 微调，在不对预训练 DINOv3 表示结构造成扭曲的前提下捕获像素级伪影线索，从而实现 AI 生成图像检测中对齐与非对齐训练数据的互补监督，在九个基准上达到 SOTA 性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AI 生成图像检测工作表明，训练数据对齐（aligned training data）可以去除虚假相关性并提升泛化能力。然而，实验发现即使在非对齐（misaligned）数据集上训练的线性探针，只要基于冻结的 DINOv3 特征，也能取得惊人表现，说明泛化源于特征忠实表达了真实图像的分布空间。但 DINOv3 最终层对像素级伪影线索（pixel-artifact cues）的捕获能力较弱，而这些线索正是对齐训练数据所能强调的。简单混合对齐与非对齐数据虽能提升对伪影的敏感性，却会扭曲预训练表示结构、损害泛化。因此需要一种方法同时利用两类数据的互补监督，而不破坏原始表示。

Method: 作者提出 Anchor-Regularized Adaptation (ARA)：首先剖析了冻结 DINOv3 泛化良好的原因——其决策依赖的特征忠实建模了真实图像空间，但末层对像素级伪影捕获不足。为弥补此缺陷，采用 Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) 在适配阶段专门学习捕获像素级伪影，同时引入一个冻结的锚定分类器（frozen anchor classifier）作为正则化约束，使适配过程不偏离原始 DINOv3 的表示结构。该设计使得模型能在不牺牲泛化能力的前提下利用像素伪影线索，实现对齐与非对齐数据监督的互补融合。

Result: 该方法在九个多样且具有挑战性的基准数据集上取得了 state-of-the-art (SOTA) 性能。论文通过系统分析验证了两个核心观察：(1) 冻结 DINOv3 的良好表现源于其决策依赖的特征忠实表示真实图像空间；(2) 其最终层对对齐训练数据可强调的微妙像素伪影线索捕获不足。实验进一步表明，采用 ARA 后，模型既能通过 LoRA 增强对像素伪影的敏感性，又借助冻结锚定分类器维持表示结构稳定，从而在对齐与非对齐数据混合场景中实现更强的检测效果。

Conclusion: 核心贡献在于：(1) 揭示了冻结 DINOv3 在 AI 生成图像检测中泛化良好的内在机制；(2) 识别出 DINOv3 末层对像素伪影捕获的局限及简单数据混合策略的表示扭曲问题；(3) 提出 ARA 这一轻量适配方案，通过 LoRA 加冻结锚定分类器正则化的组合，实现了对齐/非对齐数据监督的互补利用，兼顾检测敏感性与泛化性。潜在局限包括：对 LoRA 秩、正则化强度等超参数的敏感性，以及其机制分析主要基于特定特征空间（DINOv3），对其他预训练表示的适用性尚待验证。

Abstract: Recent works in AI-generated image detection have shown that careful training data alignment can improve generalization by removing spurious correlations. However, linear probes on frozen DINOv3 representations achieve remarkably strong performance even when trained on misaligned datasets. Motivated by this result, we analyze the underlying rationale and the limits of this generalization. We find that frozen DINOv3 performs well because its decisions rely on features that faithfully represent the space of authentic images. At the same time, its final layer is less effective at capturing the subtle pixel-artifact cues that can be emphasized by aligned training data. We further observe that naively mixing aligned and misaligned data during adaptation improves sensitivity to such cues but at the cost of distorting the pre-trained representation, limiting generalization. To address this issue, we propose Anchor-Regularized Adaptation (ARA). We apply Low-Rank Adaptation to capture pixel-level artifacts while leveraging a frozen anchor classifier to avoid deviations from the original representation structure. This allows the model to exploit pixel-artifact cues without sacrificing generalization. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on nine diverse and challenging benchmarks, indicating that ARA enables complementary supervision from misaligned and aligned data for more effective detection.

</details>


### [62] [TERRA: A Hierarchical Parallel Training and Memory Orchestration Framework for High-Resolution AI-based Earth Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15211)
*Ruohan Wu,Ziqi Zhu,Yang Zhao,Jiarui Tang,Yingzhe Cui,Junshi Chen,Zhao Jing,Jun Shi,Hong An*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TERRA是一个面向高分辨率地球预报模型的分层并行训练框架。它提出采样感知的窗口/序列/张量并行（SAWSTP），在分布式执行中同时支持卷积采样模块和移位窗口Swin Transformer；并提出内存编排（MO）策略用于长时程（long-lead）微调，结合输入缓冲与预算约束的激活卸载，在96块H200 GPU上支持高达114亿参数的模型，峰值算力达39.76 PFLOPS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率AI地球预报模型训练极其消耗内存。窗口化Swin Transformer虽能降低全局注意力的二次方计算成本，但现有分布式系统（如AERIS）主要面向逐像素模型，不能同时支持卷积采样模块与移位窗口执行——前者需要空间连续布局，后者需要token重排。此外，长时程 rollout 微调会进一步增加激活内存，使得小patch尺寸和更长rollout的高精度微调难以实现。

Method: TERRA包含两大关键技术：(1) SAWSTP（采样感知的窗口/序列/张量并行）：将Transformer计算统一到窗口-序列-张量三元并行维度，对卷积采样模块保留空间连续的数据布局，而对Swin Transformer执行则将token路由到拓扑感知的不规则ragged窗口布局，兼顾两种算子的并行需求；(2) Memory Orchestration（内存编排）：针对长时程微调，提供rollout感知的检查点规划，并将输入缓冲与预算约束的激活卸载结合，在有限内存预算下动态卸载/重组激活。

Result: 在基于1/12° GLORYS的Wenhai工作负载上，TERRA在96块H200 GPU上支持高达114亿参数的模型，持续算力达39.76 PFLOPS，强扩展效率65.0%，弱扩展效率94.1%。与仅使用检查点（checkpoint-only）策略相比，MO将峰值分配GPU内存降低32.2%–51.8%，同时步时开销不超过20.0%，从而使得更小patch尺寸与更长rollout的微调变得可行，带来更高的预报精度。

Conclusion: TERRA的核心贡献是为混合了卷积采样与移位窗口Transformer的高分辨率地球预报模型提供了统一的分层并行训练方案，首次在分布式系统中协同支持两类算子的布局需求，并通过内存编排显著降低长时程微调的内存峰值。局限在于其评估集中于单个GLORYS-based工作负载，且步时开销上限为20%可能对超长rollout任务产生累积影响。

Abstract: Training high-resolution AI-based Earth forecasting models is memory-intensive. Window-based Swin Transformers reduce the quadratic cost of global attention, but existing distributed systems such as AERIS primarily target pixel-level models and do not jointly support convolutional sampling modules and shifted-window execution. Long-lead rollout finetuning further increases activation memory. To address these challenges, we present TERRA, a hierarchical parallel training framework for high-resolution Earth forecasting. TERRA introduces Sampling-Aware Window, Sequence, and Tensor Parallelism (SAWSTP), which preserves spatially contiguous layouts for sampling modules and routes tokens into topology-aware ragged window layouts for Transformer execution. For long-lead finetuning, Memory Orchestration (MO) provides rollout-aware checkpoint planning and combines input buffering with budget-constrained activation offloading. Experiments on the $1/12^\circ$ GLORYS-based Wenhai workload show that TERRA supports models with up to 11.4B parameters on 96 H200 GPUs and sustains up to $39.76$ PFLOPS, achieving $65.0\%$ strong-scaling and $94.1\%$ weak-scaling efficiency. Compared with checkpoint-only policies, MO further reduces peak allocated GPU memory by $32.2\%$--$51.8\%$ with at most $20.0\%$ step-time overhead, which makes finetuning with smaller patch sizes and longer rollouts feasible for improved forecasting accuracy.

</details>


### [63] [DCA-MoE: Spatially Adaptive Cross-Layer Fusion and Density-Routed Experts for Crowd Counting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15213)
*Hao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 DCA-MoE 框架，通过在保持冻结 DINOv3 编码器的条件下，让特征融合和感受野分配两种决策都变得内容相关（content-dependent），以提升密集人群计数的局部密度估计精度。核心创新包括空间自适应层融合（SALF）和密度路由多感受野专家（DR-MoE），在 NWPU-Crowd 验证集上达到 31.7 MAE / 72.2 RMSE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集人群计数面临透视形变、头部尺度变化、遮挡和背景杂乱等严重挑战，需要恢复可靠且鲁棒的局部密度。现有计数损失虽提供了强空间监督，但许多多层级解码器仍采用空间不变的（spatially invariant）特征融合方式，并对每个位置都套用单一的感受野模式。这种静态、内容无关的设计无法适应不同位置的尺度差异和上下文需求。作者指出，融合权重和感受野选择都应是依赖内容（content-dependent）的决策，从而在不同空间位置自适应地聚合多层特征并选用合适的上下文范围，这是提升局部密度估计精度的关键。

Method: DCA-MoE 框架包含两个关键技术组件：(1) 空间自适应层融合（Spatially Adaptive Layer Fusion, SALF）：对来自 DINOv3 的四层对齐骨干特征，逐位置预测融合权重（position-wise weights），使特征融合随空间位置的内容而变化；(2) 密度路由多感受野专家（Density-Routed Multi-Receptive-Field Experts, DR-MoE）：为每个位置分配局部、中距离、大上下文三种残差专家的软混合（soft mixture），使感受野选择也随内容动态调整。此外，使用 EBC 风格的头部重构块级（block-level）密度图，采用 DMCount 监督，并引入辅助路由平衡项（routing-balance term）来训练解码器，而骨干网络保持冻结不更新，利于高效训练。

Result: 在 NWPU-Crowd 验证集上，最强的配对配置基于 DINOv3 ViT-L/16，取得 31.7 MAE 和 72.2 RMSE；匹配的 ViT-B/16 完整模型获得配对 32.2/75.9。跨数据集（cross-dataset）结果仍好坏参半（mixed），且多个组件基线目前报告的是从单一随机种子选取的独立最小值（independently selected minima）。结果表明空间自适应融合与路由是可行的，但更广泛的配对评估（paired）和多样本（multi-seed）评价仍为因果归因所必需。

Conclusion: 主要贡献在于提出 DCA-MoE，首次将特征融合与感受野选择同时变为内容相关决策，并证实了其在下游计数任务上的可行性；同时严格冻结骨干，训练高效。局限在于：跨数据集泛化表现不稳定，部分消融基线仅报告单种子最小值而非配对结果，导致组件贡献的因果归因尚不充分，需要更严谨的配对与多样本评测来支撑结论。

Abstract: Crowd counting must recover reliable local density under severe variations in perspective, head scale, occlusion, and background clutter. Although modern counting objectives provide strong spatial supervision, many multi-level decoders still use spatially invariant feature fusion and apply one receptive-field pattern to every location. We propose DCA-MoE, a framework that makes both decisions content dependent while retaining a frozen DINOv3 encoder. Spatially Adaptive Layer Fusion (SALF) predicts position-wise weights over four aligned backbone features, and Density-Routed Multi-Receptive-Field Experts (DR-MoE) assigns each location a soft mixture of local, mid-range, and large-context residual experts. An EBC-style head reconstructs block density, while DMCount supervision and an auxiliary routing-balance term train the decoder without updating the backbone. On the NWPU-Crowd validation split, the strongest paired configuration, based on DINOv3 ViT-L/16, obtains 31.7 MAE and 72.2 RMSE; the matched ViT-B/16 full model obtains a paired 32.2/75.9. Cross-dataset results remain mixed, and several component baselines currently report independently selected minima from a single seed. The evidence therefore supports the feasibility of spatially adaptive fusion and routing, while broader paired and multi-seed evaluation remains necessary for causal attribution.

</details>


### [64] [Self-Supervised Topologically Invariant Manifold Learning for Railway Image Quality Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15217)
*Tingqiong Cui,Yibu Yang,Yang Li,Jiahao Fu,Xiaoliu Luo,Xu Wang,Mengzhu Wang,Siyuan Liu,Guanghui Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种完全自监督的无参考图像质量评估（BIQA）框架，基于边界约束下的拓扑不变流形学习。通过随机裁剪构造渐进背景稀释尺度，利用目标信息密度单调衰减建立自约束质量流形，经线性化空间矩投影消除几何畸变，并经单调性散度滤波筛选出精英评估器池，最后由带主成分稳定器的M-估计器将各指标融合为渐进有效的伪真值，无需任何人工标注即可在真实世界域中获得良好的零样本迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无参考图像质量评估（BIQA）方法高度依赖合成失真数据和主观标注，导致其在真实世界域中的泛化能力受限。合成失真与真实失真之间存在分布差异，而主观评分标注成本高昂且难以规模化。该问题在工业监控、铁路巡检等真实场景中尤为突出，因为这些领域缺乏标准的合成失真模型和大规模人工标注。因此，亟需一种无需人工标签、能够在真实世界域中构建稳定质量参考的自监督BIQA框架。

Method: 框架核心包含四个关键技术环节：(1) 渐进背景稀释尺度构造——围绕每个目标进行重复随机裁剪，生成多尺度图像，利用目标信息密度沿尺度单调衰减的特性建立自约束质量流形；(2) 线性化空间矩投影——消除随机裁剪引入的几何畸变，保证流形表示的几何一致性；(3) 单调性散度滤波——通过剪除对背景敏感的评估器，从11个基线指标中隔离出精英评估器集合M_elite；(4) 鲁棒M-估计器融合——结合主成分稳定器，将精英评估器融合为渐近有效的伪真值q_PGT，使方差收缩至Cramér-Rao下界。整套框架在拓扑不变性假设下运行，无需人工标注。

Result: 在CSIQ、LIVEC、LIVE-2等标准合成与真实world基准上，从11个基线指标蒸馏出的精英评估器池展现了优异的零样本迁移性能。在CQU铁路车辆监控数据集（2,797幅图像）上部署时，流形余弦相似度>0.999，且在工业极端应力下的存活率达100.0%，验证了其跨范式解耦能力与拓扑鲁棒性。评价指标涵盖零样本迁移准确率及工业场景下的流形一致性与稳定性。

Conclusion: 主要贡献在于提出了一种完全自监督、免标注的BIQA范式，通过拓扑不变流形学习构建无需人工标签的稳定质量参考，解决了合成失真与真实域之间的泛化鸿沟。其显著性在于：首次以topology-manifold理论框架统一了多指标融合与不确定性问题，且伪真值方差可收敛至Cramér-Rao下界。局限在于：质量流形的构建依赖"目标信息密度随背景稀释单调衰减"这一假设，对于内容极其复杂或裁剪语义剧变的图像可能不完全成立；此外实验规模（尤其是真实工业场景）仍有限，跨更多域的鲁棒性有待进一步验证。

Abstract: Existing blind image quality assessment (BIQA) methods typically rely on synthetic distortions and subjective annotations, limiting generalization in real-world domains. To address this, we propose a fully self-supervised BIQA framework based on topologically invariant manifold learning under boundary constraints, which constructs a stable quality reference without manual labels. The framework generates progressive background dilution scales via repeated random cropping around each target; exploiting the monotonic degradation of target information density across these scales, it establishes a self-constrained quality manifold. A linearized spatial moment projection eliminates geometric distortions from random cropping; then a monotonicity divergence filter prunes background-sensitive evaluators, isolating an elite pool \(\mathcal{M}_{\text{elite}}\). A robust M-estimator with a principal component stabilizer fuses the metrics into an asymptotically efficient pseudo-ground truth \(q_{\text{PGT}}\), contracting variance toward the Cramér-Rao lower bound. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that the elite evaluator pool, distilled from 11 baseline metrics, secures superior zero-shot transferability across standard synthetic and wild benchmarks (CSIQ, LIVEC, LIVE-2). Concurrently, deployments on the CQU Railway Rolling Stock Surveillance Dataset (2,797 images) yield a manifold cosine similarity \(>0.999\) and a 100.0\% survival rate under industrial extreme stresses, robustly validating its cross-paradigm decoupling and topological resilience.

</details>


### [65] [PersonaDrive: Controllable Trajectory Prediction with Multi-Dimensional Driving Personas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15230)
*Chan Lee,Kimin Yun,Yuseok Bae,Seong Tae Kim,Jung Uk Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Persona-Conditioned Trajectory (PCT)数据集与PersonaDrive框架，将驾驶人格分解为"时间紧迫性(Temporal Urgency)"和"乘坐舒适性(Ride Comfort)"两个正交轴，构成3×3共九种人格网格，每种人格配有自然语言描述和轨迹。PersonaDrive通过Persona-Conditioned Anchor Transform (PCAT)在两组轴上层次化重塑锚点，并用Persona-Conditioned Multi-Modal Fusion (PCMF)进行BEV级人格融合，由Hierarchical Guide Loss和Axis-Decomposed Diversity Loss训练，实现从语言条件生成人格专属轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶与轨迹预测方法虽提升了城市环境下的鲁棒性，但缺乏有意义的可控性(controllability)。关键问题在于：现有基准要么没有提供人格条件标注，要么仅支持单一紧迫性谱系(如emergency/normal/relaxed)，无法区分具有相同紧迫性但需要不同驾驶动力学(如舒适但平缓、舒适但激进等)的人格。因此需要更细粒度、多维度的驾驶人格表示，以支持按用户偏好生成可解释、可控制的轨迹。

Method: 论文包含两大技术贡献：(1) PCT数据集：将驾驶人格沿Temporal Urgency与Ride Comfort两个轴各取三个等级，组合成3×3九种人格网格，每种人格配自然语言描述与轨迹标注。(2) PersonaDrive框架：包含Persona-Conditioned Anchor Transform (PCAT)，沿两个轴层次化重塑轨迹锚点以编码人格；Persona-Conditioned Multi-Modal Fusion (PCMF)在BEV层面进行人格融合；训练由Hierarchical Guide Loss(强制沿轴对齐的物理排序)和Axis-Decomposed Diversity Loss(防止对角模式坍缩)监督，从语言描述中学习驾驶人格并生成人格专属轨迹。

Result: PersonaDrive在PCT数据集上进行了多维度场景的实验评估，结果表明其相较对比基线(baselines)在多种指标上持续取得性能提升。具体实验细节与指标数值需参考论文正文，摘要明确报告了PersonaDrive在多维场景下的稳定性改进，且代码与PCT数据集已开源。

Conclusion: 主要贡献在于提出了首个将驾驶人格分解为双轴(Temporal Urgency×Ride Comfort)九人格网格的PCT数据集，以及从语言条件生成人格专属轨迹的PersonaDrive框架，为自动驾驶轨迹预测提供了细粒度、可解释的控制维度。该方法对事件相机/SNN等本文未涉及，主要面向端到端自动驾驶中的用户偏好建模。潜在局限包括：人格轴的正交性与可组合性假设可能过于简化真实驾驶风格，且性能提升主要在合成/标注人格场景下验证，实际部署中的泛化与迁移有待进一步研究。

Abstract: Although recent trajectory prediction and end-to-end autonomous driving methods improve robustness in urban environments, they still lack meaningful controllability. Existing benchmarks either provide no persona-conditioned annotations or support only a single urgency spectrum (i.e., emergency, normal, relaxed), which cannot distinguish personas that share the same urgency level but require different driving dynamics. To address this, we propose (i) the Persona-Conditioned Trajectory (PCT) dataset, which decomposes driving personas along two axes, Temporal Urgency and Ride Comfort, and combines three levels of each to form a grid of nine personas, each paired with natural-language descriptions and trajectories, and (ii) PersonaDrive, a framework that can learn driving personas from language and can generate persona-specific trajectories. PersonaDrive incorporates Persona-Conditioned Anchor Transform (PCAT), which hierarchically reshapes anchors along both axes, and Persona-Conditioned Multi-Modal Fusion (PCMF) for BEV-level persona fusion. Training is supervised by a Hierarchical Guide Loss enforcing axis-aligned physical orderings and an Axis-Decomposed Diversity Loss preventing diagonal mode collapse. Experimental results show that PersonaDrive consistently improves over the compared baselines across multi-dimensional scenarios. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于VLLM的AIGI检测器存在两个关键局限：(1) 主要微调语言侧，对低层视觉取证线索关注不足——而这些线索恰恰是AI生成图像检测的核心依据（如噪声模式、伪影、频谱特征等非语义线索）；(2) 过度依赖手工设计的提示词或人工标注的解释理由(rationales)，限制了可扩展性。由于真实应用中缺乏专家级文本标注，如何仅用廉价、易获取的二分类标签来同时驱动视觉判别和语言输出训练，成为一个亟待解决的核心问题。

Result: 在GenImage基准上，UC-VLM取得96.1%的平均准确率，超过此前最强结果4.6%。在Chameleon数据集的ProGAN与SDV1.4训练设定下，分别取得69.6%和77.9%的准确率，超越最优基线11.2%和15.3%。这些结果表明，仅依赖二分类监督的UC-VLM在跨生成器泛化上具有明显优势，尤其在Chameleon这一面向跨域/跨生成器鲁棒性验证的基准上提升幅度更为显著。

Conclusion: UC-VLM的主要贡献在于：(1) 提出统一的多阶段二分类监督框架，将同一真实性标签复用于视觉判别和标签条件文本生成，解决了VLLM检测器中低层取证线索关注不足的问题；(2) 通过自动指令变体优化消除对手工提示词的依赖，提升可扩展性。其局限可能包括：尽管在多个基准上表现优异，但对未知新型生成模型（超出训练分布之外的生成器）的泛化能力仍需进一步验证，且多阶段训练框架的计算开销未在文中展开说明。

Abstract: Vision-Language Large Models (VLLMs) are promising for AI-generated image (AIGI) detection because they can produce both a prediction and a natural-language output. However, most existing VLLM-based detectors primarily fine-tune the language side while giving limited attention to low-level visual forensic cues. They also often depend on manually crafted prompts or human-annotated rationales, which limits scalability.We present UC-VLM, a unified multi-stage framework for AIGI detection that relies solely on binary supervision. UC-VLM first identifies effective instruction variants automatically. It then reuses the same binary label within a multi-stage training framework: (i) a visual discrimination objective that strengthens sensitivity to non-semantic forensic cues, and (ii) a label-conditioned generation objective that uses the binary label to supervise textual outputs. This design turns weak binary supervision into a shared supervision signal for both the visual pathway and the language output. Our key novelty is a unified multi-stage binary-supervised framework that consistently reuses the same authenticity labels for visual adaptation and label-conditioned text generation, while leveraging automatically optimized instructions to reduce prompt sensitivity without requiring human-written rationales or hand-crafted prompts.Experiments show that UC-VLM achieves 96.1% average accuracy on GenImage, exceeding the strongest prior result by 4.6%, and obtains 69.6% / 77.9% accuracy on Chameleon under ProGAN / SDV1.4 training, surpassing the best baseline by 11.2% / 15.3%, respectively.

### [67] [CG-GLORE: A Conjugate Gradient-Based Global-Local Regularization Network for Sparse-View CT Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15246)
*Tran Xuan Hieu Le,Doanh C. Bui,Vu Trung Duong Le,Hoai Luan Pham,Khang Nguyen,Mai K. Nguyen,Tu Bao Ho,Yasuhiko Nakashima*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CG-GLORE，一种受二阶优化启发的紧凑深度展开框架，用于稀疏视角CT重建。每个展开阶段通过CG求解基于结构化Hessian替身的线性系统，保留数据保真项的物理诱导曲率，同时用单位阵近似学习得到的正则项。图像先验由全局-局部正则化网络（GLORE）建模，结合卷积局部特征提取和基于稀疏分块与Nyström注意力的长程依赖表示模块，在捕捉解剖细节与非局部依赖的同时保持实用复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏视角CT通过减少投影视角来降低辐射剂量，但对应的逆问题是高度病态的，常产生严重条状伪影。现有深度重建方法虽有不错效果，但多数依赖一阶更新或大型正则化网络，在病态条件下效率与效果有限。因此需要一种既利用物理诱导的曲率信息（二阶思想）又保持紧凑高效的深度展开重建框架。

Method: CG-GLORE采用深度展开（deep unrolling）结构。每个展开阶段用CG（共轭梯度）求解一个线性系统：该系统基于结构化Hessian替身，其中数据保真项保留CT物理诱导的曲率，而学习得到的正则项用恒等近似，属于"二阶启发"而非对完整学习目标的精确牛顿法。图像先验由GLORE网络建模，它将卷积局部特征提取与Long-Range Dependency Representation模块结合，后者基于稀疏分块（patchification）与Nyström注意力实现长程依赖捕捉，兼顾解剖细节与非局部依赖的同时控制计算复杂度。

Result: 在AAPM和DeepLesion数据集上，在多种稀疏视角配置与噪声设置下进行实验。结果表明CG-GLORE相比代表性重建方法取得更强的定量性能、更稳定的收敛性、更低的噪声功率以及更好的视觉保真度。

Conclusion: 主要贡献在于将二阶优化思想（CG求解基于物理曲率的结构化Hessian替身的线性系统）与紧凑的全局-局部正则化网络相结合，为稀疏视角CT重建提供了高效且鲁棒的解决方案。其显著意义在于在病态重建场景中兼顾了稳定性、低噪声与视觉质量。可能的局限包括：对正则项采用单位近似使其并非严格的牛顿法，对某些病态更强的先验可能不是最优；复杂度与超参数（如CG迭代次数、展开阶段数）的敏感性、以及跨数据集泛化性需进一步验证。

Abstract: Sparse-view computed tomography (CT) reduces radiation dose by acquiring fewer projection views, but the resulting inverse problem is highly ill-posed and often produces severe streak artifacts. Existing deep reconstruction methods have achieved promising performance, yet many rely on first-order updates or large regularization networks, which can be less effective in ill-conditioned settings. We propose \textbf{CG-GLORE}, a compact deep unrolling framework inspired by second-order optimization for sparse-view CT reconstruction. Each unrolled stage uses a CG-solved linear system based on a structured Hessian surrogate: it retains the physics-induced curvature of the data-fidelity term while using an identity approximation for the learned regularization term. Thus, the method is second-order-inspired rather than an exact Newton method for the full learned objective. To model image priors, we design a Global-Local Regularization Network (GLORE), which combines convolutional local feature extraction with a Long-Range Dependency Representation module based on sparse patchification and Nyström attention. This design captures anatomical details and non-local dependencies while maintaining practical complexity. Experiments on AAPM and DeepLesion under multiple sparse-view and noise settings show that CG-GLORE achieves strong quantitative performance, stable convergence, lower noise power, and improved visual fidelity compared with representative reconstruction methods.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航拍-地面图像联合三维重建是生成高精度城市三维模型的关键，但航拍与地面视角之间存在剧烈的视点、尺度和旋转差异，使得鲁棒特征匹配极具挑战性。传统检测器依赖的方法在视角明显变化时特征重复性差，而现有无检测器匹配方法（如LoFTR）对旋转变化不敏感，难以应对航拍-地面这种跨视角场景。该问题直接影响增量式SFM中相机位姿估计与稠密重建的精度，因此需要一种针对旋转鲁棒且计算高效的匹配框架。

Method: 论文提出旋转鲁棒无检测器匹配网络，包含四个关键模块：（1）旋转感知特征提取：用全向状态空间块（OSS Block）替代传统卷积，沿八个对称方向选择性扫描，建模长程空间依赖并合成旋转不变特征图，借鉴状态空间模型（SSM）的思路；（2）多尺度注意力变换：采用四叉树注意力构建层次化token金字塔，隔离高关联token区域并丢弃无关区域，以线性计算复杂度捕获长程上下文；（3）双向特征匹配：执行对称的由粗到细匹配方案——粗对齐在互近邻约束下计算双向Softmax置信度矩阵，细对齐用多层感知机回归亚像素级坐标偏移；（4）多视角轨迹细化：用集成索引结构评估局部空间邻近性，将断开的子轨迹连接到最高置信度锚点，保证特征在ISfM全流程中的稳定重复性。

Result: 实验采用真实航拍-地面数据集。结果表明，与LoFTR相比，所提方法在5°位姿误差下的AUC提升93.9%，并在ISfM重建中取得最高精度，精度提升幅度为27.6%至32.7%。这验证了旋转鲁棒匹配结合轨迹细化对跨视角联合重建的有效性。

Conclusion: 论文的主要贡献在于：将状态空间模型的全向扫描思想引入无检测器特征匹配，有效解决航拍-地面跨视角下的旋转鲁棒性问题；结合四叉树注意力与粗细匹配实现高效精确匹配；并通过多视角轨迹细化显著提升ISfM重建精度。局限之处可能包括：实验集中于具体航拍-地面数据集的验证，对极端场景（如弱纹理、动态遮挡）的泛化能力尚未充分讨论；此外OSS Block的多方向扫描尽管并行可控，但在大规模图像上的计算开销与实时性仍有待评估。

Abstract: Integrated 3D reconstruction from aerial-ground images is essential for generating high-precision urban 3D models, yet severe variations in viewpoint, scale, and rotation make robust feature matching highly challenging. To address these limitations, this study introduces a rotation-robust detector-free matching network coupled with multi-view track refinement for incremental Structure from Motion (ISfM). The proposed workflow features four key modules. First, rotation-aware feature extraction replaces traditional convolutions with an Omnidirectional State Space Block (OSS Block) that selectively scans across eight symmetrical directions to model long-range spatial dependencies and synthesize rotation-invariant feature maps. Second, multi-scale attention transformation utilizes quadtree attention to build a hierarchical token pyramid that isolates high-association token regions and discards irrelevant areas, capturing long-range context with linear computational complexity. Third, bi-directional feature matching executes a symmetric coarse-to-fine matching scheme where coarse alignment computes dual-direction Softmax confidence matrices under mutual nearest neighbor constraints, and fine alignment uses a multi-layer perceptron to regress sub-pixel coordinate offsets. Finally, multi-view track refinement employs an integrated indexing structure to evaluate localized spatial proximity and link disjoint sub-tracks to the highest-confidence anchor point, ensuring stable feature repeatability across the ISfM pipeline. By using real aerial-ground datasets, experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method improves AUC at 5° pose error by 93.9% compared with LoFTR and achieves the highest precision in ISfM reconstruction, with the improved accuracy ranging from 27.6% to 32.7%. The proposed method provides a reliable solution for integrated 3D reconstruction of aerial-ground images.

</details>

*Zhiqiang Hu,Shouren Huang,Masatoshi Ishikawa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向无人机视频运动去模糊的计算高效方法，核心包括自适应潜空间尺度选择器（Adaptive Latent Scale Selector）和多帧对齐与可学习门控模块（Multi-Frame Alignment and Learnable Gating），在兼顾细节恢复与推理效率的同时提升目标检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机在灾后响应、交通监控等场景中至关重要，但其快速飞行机动、振动和相机平移会导致严重的运动模糊，严重退化目标检测等下游任务。现有去模糊方法通常计算开销大，且单帧或简单多帧处理难以在保持时间一致性的同时兼顾效率与细节，因此需要一种高效且有效的视频去模糊方案来增强无人机目标检测。

Method: 方法包含两个关键创新模块：(1) Adaptive Latent Scale Selector：根据无人机运动强度动态调整去模糊网络的潜空间分辨率——运动剧烈时用更高分辨率以保留细节，运动平缓时降低分辨率以提升推理效率，实现细节保留与推理效率的动态平衡。(2) Multi-Frame Alignment and Learnable Gating：对前序帧进行warp对齐，并通过可学习门控机制只融合相关的时间信息、抑制对齐不良或无信息的特征，从而保证输出帧的时间一致性。整体模型在真实无人机视频流上端到端恢复清晰细节。

Result: 在真实无人机基准数据集上进行广泛实验。结果显示，该方法不仅取得优于现有方法的去模糊性能（PSNR等指标），而且显著提升下游目标检测精度，证明其在鲁棒空中视觉任务中的实用价值，尤其在提升检测准确率方面具有明显优势。

Conclusion: 主要贡献：(1) 首次面向无人机目标检测提出计算高效的视频去模糊框架；(2) 提出自适应潜空间尺度选择器以动态平衡细节与效率；(3) 提出预测对齐与可学习门控融合模块以保证时间一致性并抑制错误信息。局限可能在于运动强度估计的准确性对尺度选择的影响，以及对极端模糊或复杂场景泛化能力的验证仍需进一步补充。

Abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) play a crucial role in various scenarios ranging from disaster response to traffic surveillance. However, aerial video footage often suffers from severe motion blur due to rapid flight maneuvers, vibrations, and camera panning, which can significantly degrade downstream tasks such as target detection. Our goal is to explore a computationally-efficient and effective video deblurring approach to enhance UAV target detection performance. To reduce computational cost, we first propose an Adaptive Latent Scale Selector that dynamically adjusts the latent space resolution according to the intensity of UAV motion, thus balancing detail preservation with inference efficiency. To ensure temporal consistency, we introduce a Multi-Frame Alignment and Learnable Gating module to warp and gate the preceding frames, allowing the model to fuse only relevant temporal information and suppress misaligned or uninformative features. Our method can effectively recover sharp details from the UAV video stream. Extensive experiments on real UAV benchmarks demonstrate that our method not only yields superior deblurring performance but also significantly boosts target detection accuracy, making it highly applicable to robust aerial vision tasks.

*Wei Zhang,Yihang Wu,Songhua Li,Qi Wang*

TL;DR: 本文提出一种尺度一致性增强框架SGIA（Scene Geometric Invariant Anchoring），用于长序列3D重建中的尺度漂移校正。核心思想是利用结构环境中几何量（如平面法线、点间距等）在时间片段间的不变性，通过粗到细的鲁棒估计提取场景几何不变量，将7自由度Sim(3)对齐显式退化为6自由度刚体变换，从根源切断链式尺度误差传播；同时引入仅微调归一化层参数的轻量测试时自适应策略，逐片段改善帧内预测。框架即插即用，无需离线重训练，在多个长序列基准上将绝对轨迹误差降低最多32%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长序列3D重建（如驾驶场景）中，scale drift（尺度漂移）是最关键的失效模式。在基于分块（chunk-based）的推理管线中，相邻片段之间做顺序Sim(3)对齐时，尺度自由度未被约束，估计误差会按乘法方式逐块累积，导致全局轨迹和点云几何严重畸变。现有的后处理策略多依赖点云配准或全局优化，无法在源头解除尺度不确定性。由于该问题直接影响自动驾驶、机器人导航等对几何精度要求高的应用，亟需一种不依赖离线重训练、可即插即用的尺度一致性校正方案。

Method: 方法包含两大即插即用模块：

1) Scene Geometric Invariant Anchoring (SGIA)：核心洞见是结构化环境（如驾驶场景）中，源于环境规则性的几何量（如平面结构、对称性、规则距离）在时间片段之间具有内在不变性。SGIA从每个片段预测的点云中，通过粗到细（coarse-to-fine）的鲁棒估计提取这些主导几何不变量，利用其跨片段一致性构建尺度约束——该约束不依赖点云配准，从而将7-DoF的Sim(3)对齐显式退化为6-DoF的刚体SE(3)变换，在源头切断链式尺度误差传播。

2) 轻量测试时自适应（Test-Time Adaptation）：通过多目标自监督损失，仅微调归一化层参数，沿序列逐片段渐进改善片段内（intra-chunk）预测质量。

两个模块均无需离线重训练，可无缝嵌入现有分块式重建管线。

Result: 在多个长序列3D重建基准上进行实验，与现有方法相比达到SOTA性能。绝对轨迹误差（ATE）最多降低32%，同时在轨迹稳定性和重建质量上取得显著提升。实验涵盖驾驶等结构化场景的长序列重建任务，验证了SGIA跨片段尺度约束和测试时自适应策略的有效性。代码已开源（https://github.com/WZ-CS/VGGT-Align）。

Conclusion: 本文的贡献在于：(1) 提出利用场景几何不变量作为跨片段尺度锚点的新视角，将尺度校正从配准依赖中解耦；(2) 设计SGIA将7-DoF Sim(3)对齐退化为6-DoF刚体对齐，从根源阻断尺度误差链式累积；(3) 引入仅更新归一化层的轻量测试时自适应机制，兼顾效率与精度。该方法即插即用、无需重训练，对自动驾驶、机器人SLAM等长序列在线3D重建任务具有实际意义。局限在于其有效性依赖场景中存在足够明显的几何不变量（结构化环境），对完全无结构的开放场景或强动态环境，几何不变量的提取与鲁棒性可能受限。

Abstract: Maintaining global geometric consistency is a central challenge in long-sequence 3D reconstruction, with scale drift being the most critical failure mode. In chunk-based inference pipelines, the scale degree of freedom in sequential Sim(3) alignment is left unconstrained, causing estimation errors to compound multiplicatively and distort global trajectories and point cloud geometry. We present a scale-consistency enhancement framework built on a key insight: in structured environments such as driving scenes, geometric quantities arising from environmental regularity remain inherently invariant across temporal segments, and discrepancies in their per-chunk measurements directly expose inter-chunk scale drift. We propose Scene Geometric Invariant Anchoring (SGIA), which extracts dominant geometric invariants from each chunk's predicted point cloud via coarse-to-fine robust estimation and exploits their cross-chunk consistency to establish scale constraints independent of point cloud registration, explicitly degenerating 7-DoF Sim(3) alignment into 6-DoF rigid-body transformation and severing chain-wise scale error propagation at its source. We further introduce a lightweight test-time adaptation strategy that fine-tunes only normalization-layer parameters via multi-objective self-supervision, progressively improving intra-chunk predictions along the sequence. Both modules are plug-and-play and require no offline retraining. Experiments on multiple long-sequence benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, reducing absolute trajectory error by up to 32% with significant gains in trajectory stability and reconstruction quality. Code: https://github.com/WZ-CS/VGGT-Align

</details>

*Haifa Zhang,Yijing Wang,Haoyu Wang,Zheng Li,Zhiqiang Zuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对光学-SAR遥感图像融合目标检测中"负跨模态迁移"问题，提出模型特定的任务效用视角，并设计两种不需要显式效用监督的贡献路由机制：面向浅层频繁交互架构的Feature Router（跨条件、分组可寻址调制）和面向双主干架构的Dual-Statistic Semantic Router（基于均值/最大值统计预测流级贡献权重）。在M4-SAR和SpaceNet6-OTD上验证，Full-input mAP50提升0.5-5.9点，缺失模态场景相对dropout基线提升7.6-41.6点，负迁移率最多降低12.7个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光学图像提供丰富外观信息，而SAR对光照和天气不敏感，二者融合对遥感目标检测极具吸引力。但多模态并不保证有效融合：空间、时间和语义的对齐不完美会使原本完好的模态流变得"条件性有害"，引发负跨模态迁移。作者从模型特定的任务效用（task-utility）视角出发，指出不同检测器对每个模态的真实"贡献"不同，因此需要一种以检测监督为唯一信号、不依赖额外标签或重建的机制，自适应地调节各模态的贡献权重。这一问题的关键在于区分"模态本身的效用"与"该模态在特定网络架构中对最终检测损失的贡献"。

Method: 核心思路是解决"融合边界对齐"问题：在检测器中第一次学习到的跨模态特征值混合操作之前，对每个模态的贡献进行调节。具体提出两种路由机制：(1) Feature Router——针对浅层频繁交互的融合架构，在输入附近施加跨条件（cross-conditioned）的、分组可寻址（group-addressable）的调制，对特征通道分组内进行条件化缩放/调制；(2) Dual-Statistic Semantic Router——针对双主干（dual-backbone）架构，在晚期语义融合前，从各模态的平均值和最大值统计中预测流级（stream-level）贡献权重。两种路由都仅用检测监督（检测损失）端到端训练，无需显式效用监督、质量标签、重建或蒸馏。路由权重被解释为模型特定任务效用的代理，通过Spearman相关性与"留一模态"（leave-one-modality-out）效用进行验证。

Result: 在M4-SAR和SpaceNet6-OTD两个数据集上验证，覆盖四种设置：名义完整输入、受控对应关系偏移、缺失模态、四种非零模态损坏场景。在干净训练对照下，路由使完整输入mAP50提升0.5-5.9点；相对于对应的模态dropout基线，路由在缺失模态场景下将mAP50提升7.6-41.6点，并将负迁移率最多降低12.7个百分点。此外，学习到的路由权重与模型特定的留一模态效用之间的Spearman相关系数达0.45-0.66，支持路由系数具有任务效用解释这一观点。

Conclusion: 本文的主要贡献在于：将跨模态融合中的负迁移问题重新表述为"模型特定任务效用的贡献路由"问题，并通过两种轻量、无需额外监督的路由模块在融合操作前调节模态贡献，从而同时提升完整输入和缺失模态下的检测性能。其意义在于缺乏显式质量/效用标签时仍可实现自适应的条件化模态融合，为光学-SAR等异构多模态遥感检测提供了通用范式。局限在于：路由设计针对"浅层交互"和"双主干"两类架构特化，通用性仍需更多架构验证；效用解释仅通过相关性间接支持，且实验覆盖的模态损坏场景有限；对小目标检测和实时推理效率的影响未明确给出定量结论。

Abstract: Optical imagery provides rich appearance cues, whereas synthetic aperture radar (SAR) offers observations that are less sensitive to illumination and weather, making optical--SAR fusion attractive for remote-sensing object detection. However, the presence of multiple modalities does not guarantee beneficial fusion: imperfect spatial, temporal, and semantic correspondence can make an otherwise intact stream conditionally harmful and induce negative cross-modal transfer. We handle this issue through a model-specific task-utility perspective and learn task-conditioned contribution routing using detection supervision alone. The proposed fusion-boundary-aligned routing regulates each modality's contribution before the first learned cross-modal feature-value mixing operation. For architectures with frequent shallow interaction, a Feature Router performs cross-conditioned, group-addressable modulation near the input; for dual-backbone architectures, a Dual-Statistic Semantic Router predicts stream-level contribution weights from modality-specific average and maximum statistics before late semantic fusion. The routers require no explicit utility supervision, quality labels, reconstruction, or distillation. Experiments on M4-SAR and SpaceNet6-OTD cover nominal full inputs, controlled correspondence shifts, missing modalities, and four nonzero modality-corruption scenarios. Across the reported clean-training controls, routing improves full-input $\text{mAP}_{50}$ by 0.5--5.9 points. Relative to the corresponding modality-dropout baselines, it raises missing-modality $\text{mAP}_{50}$ by 7.6--41.6 points and reduces the negative-transfer rate by up to 12.7 percentage points. ### [72] [On the Adversarial Robustness of Remote Sensing Semantic Change Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15267)
*Weikang Yu,Yonghao Xu,Pedram Ghamisi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出首个面向语义变化检测(SCD)这一双时相稠密预测任务的对抗鲁棒性评测框架。与传统方法将SCD简化为单图像分割或二值变化检测不同，该框架将输出侧攻击目标与输入侧时间扰动访问权限分离，系统性地分析了组件级脆弱性和跨时相传播特性。在四个数据集和六种代表性模型（CNN、Transformer、状态空间模型）上的实验揭示了：即使二值变化定位保持相对稳定，最终语义变化预测也可能被严重破坏；一个时相的扰动或攻击目标能够传播影响另一个时相的预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义变化检测(SCD)是双时相稠密预测任务，需要同时识别变化区域及其变化前后的语义状态。与单图像分割或二值变化检测不同，SCD耦合两个时序输入，涉及按时间戳的语义预测、变化定位和最终语义变化解码三个环节，形成对抗性依赖关系。现有的对抗鲁棒性评测协议（通常针对单图像分类或分割）无法捕获这种耦合结构的脆弱性。由于缺乏任务特定的评测框架，研究者无法系统分析SCD中各组件（语义预测分支、变化定位分支、语义变化解码）的独立脆弱性以及跨时相扰动的传播机制，这阻碍了对可部署SCD系统的安全性理解。

Method: 论文提出任务特定的对抗鲁棒性评测框架，核心创新在于将攻击维度进行系统化分解：(1) 输出侧攻击目标分离——区分针对最终语义变化预测的目标、针对语义预测分支的目标和针对变化定位的目标，评估各组件独立脆弱性；(2) 输入侧时间扰动访问权限分离——区分单时相扰动（仅扰动t1或t2）与双时相扰动；(3) 引入组件级目标和时间目标的综合评估，涵盖单/双时间戳扰动、多种攻击方法以及跨架构迁移性分析。实验覆盖CNN（如U-Net类）、Transformer和状态空间模型（如Mamba类）三种代表性架构家族，确保结论的架构普适性。

Result: 实验在四个数据集和六种代表性模型上进行。关键发现：(1) 最终语义变化预测可以被严重破坏，即使二值变化定位保持相对稳定——这证明SCD的鲁棒性瓶颈不在变化定位分支，而在语义分支或解码环节；(2) 一个时相（如t1）相关的扰动或攻击目标能传播影响另一个时相（t2）的预测，验证了跨时相的信息耦合与对抗传播；(3) 这些脆弱行为在不同架构家族（CNN、Transformer、状态空间模型）中一致出现，表明是SCD任务本身的耦合结构固有特性而非特定架构缺陷；(4) 直接的跨模型迁移攻击效果显著弱于白盒攻击，说明模型间梯度差异限制了黑盒迁移性。

Conclusion: 主要贡献：首次建立了面向SCD任务的系统性对抗鲁棒性评测协议，明确了鲁棒性评估必须基于完整的双时相预测通路而非单独分支或骨干网络家族。研究揭示了SCD任务中变化定位与语义解码之间的鲁棒性"脱耦"现象，以及跨时相扰动传播这一任务特有属性，为后续SCD安全防御提供了评测基准和代码实现开放平台。局限在于：未提出防御方法，仅聚焦于攻击面分析和评测协议设计；评测集中于白盒场景，而实际部署中黑盒攻击可能更为常见。

Abstract: Semantic change detection (SCD) is a bitemporal dense-prediction task that jointly identifies changed regions and their semantic states before and after change. Unlike single-image segmentation or binary change detection, SCD couples two temporal inputs with timestamp-wise semantic prediction, change localization, and final semantic-change decoding, creating adversarial dependencies that are not captured by conventional robustness protocols. We present a task-specific evaluation framework that separates output-side attack objectives from input-side temporal perturbation access, enabling systematic analysis of component vulnerability and cross-temporal propagation. Experiments on four datasets and six representative CNN-, Transformer-, and state-space-based models evaluate component-level and temporal objectives, single- and dual-timestamp perturbations, multiple attack methods, and cross-architecture transferability. The results show that final semantic-change predictions can be severely corrupted even when binary change localization remains comparatively stable, and that perturbations or attack objectives associated with one timestamp can propagate to the prediction of the other. These behaviors occur across different architecture families, while direct cross-model transfer remains considerably weaker than white-box attacks. The study demonstrates that adversarial robustness in SCD depends on the complete bitemporal prediction pathway rather than on an individual branch or backbone family, and provides a structured protocol for evaluating robustness in coupled bitemporal image analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/EricYu97/AdvSCD.

</details>


### [73] [Memory-Bounded Continuation of Greedy Sampling for Continual Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15277)
*Yoon Gyo Jung,Jaewoo Park,Kuan-Chuan Peng,Seongdeok Bang,Octavia Camps*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 ContCore（Continual Coreset），一种用于固定内存约束下持续异常检测（Continual Anomaly Detection, CAD）的核心集方法。核心思想是“贪心连续采样”（greedy-continued coreset）——对已贪心采样的集合反复应用贪心选择，在每步丢弃数据以满足固定内存预算的同时，保证核心集质量“优雅退化”而非灾难性失效。作者提供理论证明，说明贪心连续核心集与 oracle 核心集之间存在有界差距，并在 MVTecAD 与 VisA 的 11 种任务调度上取得 SOTA 性能，且可扩展到在线持续异常检测设置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异常检测依赖测量数据与正常分布的“距离”，因此一个紧凑却具有代表性的正常数据摘要（核心集，coreset）至关重要。在持续异常检测（任务顺序到达）场景下，若直接扩展贪心采样，需要无界内存来累积核心集，不适用于实际部署。严格的内存约束要求核心集大小不随任务数增长。问题在于：在固定内存下持续丢弃数据是否会破坏核心集的代表性，从而导致异常检测失效？神经方法易遭灾难性遗忘，而朴素核心集累积需要无界内存，两者都不令人满意。本文旨在回答：在固定内存下反复贪心选择能否保持代表性并给出理论保障。

Method: ContCore 的核心是一个“贪心连续核心集”（greedy-continued coreset）构建原则，分为两个阶段：(1) 贪婪扩张（greedy expansion）：对新任务的特征增量式应用贪心选择，纳入新分布的代表点；(2) 贪婪合并（greedy consolidation）：在达到内存预算后，对已采样的（含上一轮与本次扩张得到的）集合再次执行贪心选择以强制满足固定核心集大小。即对先前贪心采样的集合反复应用贪心选择，逐步丢弃数据。关键理论在于：作者证明这种“贪心之上再贪心”的迭代过程，所得到核心集能逼近 oracle 核心集，且误差保持一个有界间隙，说明尽管每步都在丢弃数据，核心集质量只优雅退化、不灾难性崩溃，从而可支撑可靠的跨任务异常检测。相比神经网络方法（灾难性遗忘）和朴素核心累积（无界内存），ContCore 以固定内存提供了理论保证。

Result: 实验在 MVTecAD 和 VisA 两个异常检测基准上进行，涵盖 11 种任务调度（task schedules），对比持续异常检测与在线持续异常检测设置。结果表明 ContCore 在全部 11 种调度上取得 SOTA 性能；在在线持续异常检测设置中，先前方法性能显著下降，而 ContCore 仍能稳健扩展并保持高可靠检测能力。代码已开源：https://github.com/jungyg/ContCore。

Conclusion: ContCore 的主要贡献在于：为固定内存持续异常检测提供了基于贪心连续核心集的全新原则，兼具理论保证（与 oracle 核心集的有限逼近间隙）与实证优势（11 种调度 SOTA、在线设置稳健）。其方法纯粹基于特征核心集，无需神经网络参数更新，天然规避灾难性遗忘。可能的局限包括：方法假定特征表示在任务间保持一致/可比较（即依赖预训练特征或固定特征空间），未深入讨论当特征分布显著漂移时的表现；此外理论保证了有界间隙，但实际间隙大小与任务复杂度、内存预算的数学关系尚有进一步刻画空间。对事件流、UAV 等受限内存场景下的持续感知具有方法论借鉴意义。

Abstract: Greedy sampling produces a compact yet representative summary of normal data, which is essential for reliable anomaly detection that relies on measuring distance from normality. For continual anomaly detection where tasks arrive sequentially, extending greedy sampling is straightforward with unbounded memory through coreset accumulation. However, practical deployment requires fixed memory where the coreset size remains constant regardless of task count. We observe that continued greedy sampling, which iteratively applies greedy selection over previously greedy-sampled sets, effectively preserves representativeness under strict memory limits. Despite discarding data at each step to satisfy the memory constraint, coreset quality degrades gracefully rather than catastrophically, enabling reliable anomaly detection across the tasks. We provide theoretical justification by showing that resulting greedy-continued coreset approximates the oracle coreset within a bounded gap. We instantiate this principle in ContCore, which constructs a greedy-continued coreset through greedy expansion on new task features followed by greedy consolidation to enforce the memory budget. Unlike neural methods susceptible to catastrophic forgetting or naive coreset accumulation requiring unbounded memory, ContCore maintains fixed memory with theoretical guarantees. Empirically, ContCore achieves state-of-the-art performance across 11 task schedules on MVTecAD and VisA, and extends effectively to online continual AD settings where prior methods degrade significantly. Code: https://github.com/jungyg/ContCore

</details>


### [74] [Geometry-Aware Spatio-Temporal Context Modeling for 4D Occupancy Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15279)
*Sitao Chen,Zhuangwei Zhuang,Hui Luo,Qingyao Wu,Mingkui Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种几何感知时空上下文建模方法（GAST），用于4D占据预测。该方法通过渐进式显式-隐式生成模块与双路径时空建模模块，实现端到端的联合优化，在Occ3D-nuScenes数据集上以2.84倍加速超过SOTA，mIoU提升7.67%，IoU提升6.44%。


<details>

Motivation: 4D占据预测建模3D场景的时空演化，对自动驾驶（尤其是极端场景仿真）至关重要。现有方法多依赖离散token化后进行自回归预测，存在两大痛点：一是静态结构出现几何畸变，二是长期预测中时间一致性无法保持。这些问题导致预测场景在结构保真度与时间连续性上表现不佳，制约其在真实自动驾驶仿真与安全验证中的应用。

Conclusion: 主要贡献在于提出了一种无需自回归逐token预测的4D占据预测新范式，通过渐进式显式-隐式生成与双路径时空建模，同时解决了几何保真度与时间一致性的问题，并在效率和精度上双双超越现有方法。潜在局限包括仅在单数据集（Occ3D-nuScenes）上验证，未来可在更多数据集与极端场景下验证泛化性。

Subsequently, the spatio-temporal module enhances spatial consistency through global context aggregation while capturing scene evolution through temporal dynamics extraction. This unified design enables joint optimization of historical reconstruction and future forecasting in an end-to-end manner. Extensive experiments on Occ3D-nuScenes demonstrate the superiority of our method, outperforming the state-of-the-art by 7.67% in mIoU and 6.44% in IoU with a 2.84x speedup, while maintaining strong performance in long-term forecasting.

Result: 论文在多个基准数据集上进行了广泛评估。实验结果显示，SOS在无模型未见物体分割任务上取得了新的最先进性能，在保证高精度的同时实现了高效率。具体而言，SOS证明了仅凭单张参考图像即可达到或超越依赖3D模型先验的复杂方法的性能，验证了其统一框架在准确性和效率上的双重优势。论文提供了项目主页和公开代码以供复现。

Conclusion: SOS通过Object-Conditional Transformer以身份锚定查询统一了掩码生成与目标识别，彻底消除了对3D模型先验的依赖，将无模型未见物体分割简化为只需单张参考图像的单次前向传播。该方法在多个基准上达到SOTA，兼具高精度与高效性能，对机器人操作等实时感知应用具有重要意义。其局限可能在于对参考图像质量与视角的敏感性，以及身份锚定查询在极端遮挡或外观变化场景下的鲁棒性，但具体的消融与约束分析需要在论文正文中进一步验证。

Abstract: Foundation segmentation models excel at generating high-quality, class-agnostic masks, but they struggle to associate these proposals with specific target objects. To address these limitations, we propose SOS (Streamlined Object-conditional Transformer for model-free Segmentation). SOS completely eliminates the reliance on 3D models, requiring only a single reference image per target object. Central to our framework is a novel Object-Conditional Transformer that learns identity-anchored queries, unifying mask generation and target identification into a single feed-forward pass. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SOS establishes a new state-of-the-art for model-free unseen objects segmentation, delivering accurate and high-efficiency performance.   <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 实验验证了FMReward在人类偏好对齐方面优于现有的ground-truth误差类指标（如逐顶点误差等），证明感知奖励模型更能反映真实质量。同时实验证明FMFL能有效提升音频驱动3D面部动画的感知质量，即通过奖励反馈微调后的生成模型其输出在人类偏好评估中更受青睐。实验覆盖了多种音频输入、多样化的野外场景和多种基线动画生成方法。

Conclusion: 本文的主要贡献在于：首次构建了面向音频驱动3D面部动画的人类偏好数据集FMPair，提出了人类偏好对齐的感知奖励模型FMReward，以及基于奖励反馈的微调算法FMFL，将"以人为中心"的感知建模范式引入该领域。局限性可能包括：奖励模型依赖人工偏好的标注质量与多样性、偏好数据集覆盖的动画风格和生成方法多样性有限、以及扩散模型的微调成本与可扩展性问题。该工作对事件相机/SNN/UAV等领域无直接关联，但其"以人类偏好替代ground-truth误差作为评估与优化信号"的核心思想对包括事件流感知质量评估在内的通用感知建模具有方法论借鉴意义。

Abstract: Audio-driven 3D facial animation is essential for advancing immersion and interactivity in virtual experiences. Although recent advances have shown promising capabilities, the training and evaluation of existing methods typically rely on ground-truth-based errors, which fall short of aligning with human preferences. To address this, we present a comprehensive framework that learns an automatic perceptual model from human preference data and leverages it to improve and evaluate the perceptual quality of audio-driven 3D facial animation. To begin with, we construct FMPair (Facial Motion Pairwise preference), the first human preference dataset for audio-driven 3D facial animation, which is built through a systematic annotation pipeline and comprises 65,574 annotated 3D facial motion pairs from 8,834 distinct in-the-wild audio clips. Based on the pairwise comparison dataset, we propose a Facial Motion Reward model, termed FMReward, which takes audio and 3D facial motion as inputs and predicts a perceptual quality score aligned with human preferences. Building upon FMReward, we further introduce Facial Motion reward Feedback Learning (FMFL), a direct fine-tuning algorithm that leverages a pretrained reward model to optimize diffusion-based audio-driven 3D facial animation models for better alignment with human preferences. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of FMReward over other metrics in aligning with human preferences and the effectiveness of FMFL in improving the perceptual quality of audio-driven 3D facial animation.
